4.10.s:
.. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca .. ..
atha kaṃsaḥ sabhāmadhye svarṇasiṃhāsanasthitaḥ ..
śuśrāva vācaṃ gagane sūnṛtāmaśarīriṇīm .. 1 ..
4.10.d:
॥ श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥ ॥
अथ कंसः सभामध्ये स्वर्णसिंहासनस्थितः ॥
शुश्राव वाचं गगने सूनृतामशरीरिणीम् ॥ 1 ॥

4.10.s:
kiṃ karoṣi mahāmūḍha ciṃtāṃ svaśreyasaḥ kuru ..
jātaḥ kālo dharaṇyāṃ te tiṣṭhopāye narādhipa .. 2 ..
4.10.d:
किं करोषि महामूढ चिंतां स्वश्रेयसः कुरु ॥
जातः कालो धरण्यां ते तिष्ठोपाये नराधिप ॥ 2 ॥

4.10.s:
naṃdāya tanayaṃ dattvā vasudevastavāṃtakam ..
kanyāmādāya tubhyaṃ ca dattvā saṃmāyayā sthitaḥ..3..
4.10.d:
नंदाय तनयं दत्त्वा वसुदेवस्तवांतकम् ॥
कन्यामादाय तुभ्यं च दत्त्वा संमायया स्थितः॥3॥

4.10.s:
māyāṃśā kanyakeyaṃ ca vāsudevaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ ..
tava haṃtā gokule ca varddhate naṃdamaṃdire .. 4 ..
4.10.d:
मायांशा कन्यकेयं च वासुदेवः स्वयं हरिः ॥
तव हंता गोकुले च वर्द्धते नंदमंदिरे ॥ 4 ॥

4.10.s:
devakyāḥ saptamo garbho varddhate naṃdamaṃdire ..
devakyāḥ saptamo garbho na susrāvāmṛtaṃ sutam .. 9 ..
4.10.d:
देवक्याः सप्तमो गर्भो वर्द्धते नंदमंदिरे ॥
देवक्याः सप्तमो गर्भो न सुस्रावामृतं सुतम् ॥ 9 ॥

4.10.s:
sthāpayāmāsa māyo taṃ rohiṇījaṭhare kila ..
tatra jātaśca śeṣāṃśo baladevo mahābalaḥ .. 6 ..
4.10.d:
स्थापयामास मायो तं रोहिणीजठरे किल ॥
तत्र जातश्च शेषांशो बलदेवो महाबलः ॥ 6 ॥

4.10.s:
gokule tau ca vardhete kālau te naṃdamaṃdire ..
śrutveti vacanaṃ rājā babhūvānamrakaṃdharaḥ .. 7 ..
4.10.d:
गोकुले तौ च वर्धेते कालौ ते नंदमंदिरे ॥
श्रुत्वेति वचनं राजा बभूवानम्रकंधरः ॥ 7 ॥

4.10.s:
ciṃtāmavāpa sahasā tatyājāhāramunmanāḥ ..
pūtanāṃ ca samānīya prāṇebhyaḥ preyasīṃ satīm .. 8 ..
4.10.d:
चिंतामवाप सहसा तत्याजाहारमुन्मनाः ॥
पूतनां च समानीय प्राणेभ्यः प्रेयसीं सतीम् ॥ 8 ॥

4.10.s:
uvāca bhaginīṃ rājā sabhāmadhye ca nītivit ..
..kaṃsa uvāca .. ..
pūtane gokulaṃ gaccha kāryārthaṃ naṃdamaṃdiram .. 9 ..
4.10.d:
उवाच भगिनीं राजा सभामध्ये च नीतिवित् ॥
॥कंस उवाच ॥ ॥
पूतने गोकुलं गच्छ कार्यार्थं नंदमंदिरम् ॥ 9 ॥

4.10.s:
viṣāktaṃ ca stanaṃ kṛtvā śiśave dehi satvaram ..
tvaṃ manoyāyinī vatse māyāśāstraviśāradā .. 4.10.10 ..
4.10.d:
विषाक्तं च स्तनं कृत्वा शिशवे देहि सत्वरम् ॥
त्वं मनोयायिनी वत्से मायाशास्त्रविशारदा ॥ 4.10.10 ॥

4.10.s:
māyāmānuṣarūpaṃ ca vidhāya vraja yogini ..
durvāsaso mahāmaṃtraṃ prāpya sarvatragāminī .. 11 ..
4.10.d:
मायामानुषरूपं च विधाय व्रज योगिनि ॥
दुर्वाससो महामंत्रं प्राप्य सर्वत्रगामिनी ॥ 11 ॥

4.10.s:
sarvarūpaṃ vidhātuṃ tvaṃ śaktāsi supratiṣṭhite ..
ityuktvā tāṃ mahārājastasthau saṃsadi nārada .. 12 ..
4.10.d:
सर्वरूपं विधातुं त्वं शक्तासि सुप्रतिष्ठिते ॥
इत्युक्त्वा तां महाराजस्तस्थौ संसदि नारद ॥ 12 ॥

4.10.s:
jagāma pūtanā kaṃsaṃ praṇamya kāmacāriṇī ..
taptakāṃcanavarṇābhā nānālaṃkārabhūṣitā .. 13 ..
4.10.d:
जगाम पूतना कंसं प्रणम्य कामचारिणी ॥
तप्तकांचनवर्णाभा नानालंकारभूषिता ॥ 13 ॥

4.10.s:
bibhratī kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyasaṃyutam ..
kastūrībiṃdunā yuktaṃ siṃdūraṃ dadhatī mudā .. .. 14 ..
4.10.d:
बिभ्रती कबरीभारं मालतीमाल्यसंयुतम् ॥
कस्तूरीबिंदुना युक्तं सिंदूरं दधती मुदा ॥ ॥ 14 ॥

4.10.s:
maṃjīraraśanābhyāṃ ca kalaśabdaṃ prakurvatī ..
saṃprāpya goṣṭhaṃ durdarśaṃ naṃdālayamanoharam .. 15 ..
4.10.d:
मंजीररशनाभ्यां च कलशब्दं प्रकुर्वती ॥
संप्राप्य गोष्ठं दुर्दर्शं नंदालयमनोहरम् ॥ 15 ॥

4.10.s:
parikhābhirgabhīrābhirdurlaṃghyābhiśca veṣṭitam ..
racitaṃ prastarairdivyairnirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā .. 16 ..
4.10.d:
परिखाभिर्गभीराभिर्दुर्लंघ्याभिश्च वेष्टितम् ॥
रचितं प्रस्तरैर्दिव्यैर्निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा ॥ 16 ॥

4.10.s:
iṃdranīlairmarakataiḥ padmarāgaiśca bhūṣitam ..
suvarṇakalaśairdivyaiścitritaiḥ śekharojjvalaiḥ .. 17 ..
4.10.d:
इंद्रनीलैर्मरकतैः पद्मरागैश्च भूषितम् ॥
सुवर्णकलशैर्दिव्यैश्चित्रितैः शेखरोज्ज्वलैः ॥ 17 ॥

4.10.s:
prākārairgaganasparśaiścaturdvārasamanvitaiḥ ..
yuktaṃ lohakapāṭaiśca dvārapālasamanvitaiḥ .. 18 ..
4.10.d:
प्राकारैर्गगनस्पर्शैश्चतुर्द्वारसमन्वितैः ॥
युक्तं लोहकपाटैश्च द्वारपालसमन्वितैः ॥ 18 ॥

4.10.s:
veṣṭitaṃ sundaraṃ ramyaṃ sundarīgaṇaveṣṭitam ..
muktāmāṇikyaparaśaiḥ pūrṇaratnādibhirdhanaiḥ .. 19 ..
4.10.d:
वेष्टितं सुन्दरं रम्यं सुन्दरीगणवेष्टितम् ॥
मुक्तामाणिक्यपरशैः पूर्णरत्नादिभिर्धनैः ॥ 19 ॥

4.10.s:
svarṇapātravaṭākīrṇaṃ gavāṃ koṭibhiranvitam..
bharaṇīyaiḥ kiṃkaraiśca gopalakṣaiḥ samanvitam .. 4.10.20 ..
4.10.d:
स्वर्णपात्रवटाकीर्णं गवां कोटिभिरन्वितम्॥
भरणीयैः किंकरैश्च गोपलक्षैः समन्वितम् ॥ 4.10.20 ॥

4.10.s:
dāsīnāṃ ca sahasraiśca karmavyagraiḥ samanvitam ..
praviveśāśramaṃ sādhvī sasmitā sumanoharā . .. 21 ..
4.10.d:
दासीनां च सहस्रैश्च कर्मव्यग्रैः समन्वितम् ॥
प्रविवेशाश्रमं साध्वी सस्मिता सुमनोहरा ॥। 21 ॥

4.10.s:
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ praviśaṃtīṃ ca gopyo dṛṣṭvānumenire ..
kiṃ vā padmālayā durgā kṛṣṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ samāgatā .. 22 ..
4.10.d:
दृष्ट्वा तां प्रविशंतीं च गोप्यो दृष्ट्वानुमेनिरे ॥
किं वा पद्मालया दुर्गा कृष्णं द्रष्टुं समागता ॥ 22 ॥

4.10.s:
praṇemurgopikā gopāḥ papracchuḥ kuśalaṃ ca tām ..
dadau siṃhāsanaṃ pādyaṃ vāsayāmāsa tatra vai .. 23 ..
4.10.d:
प्रणेमुर्गोपिका गोपाः पप्रच्छुः कुशलं च ताम् ॥
ददौ सिंहासनं पाद्यं वासयामास तत्र वै ॥ 23 ॥

4.10.s:
papraccha kuśalaṃ sā ca gopānāṃ bālakasya ca ..
uvāsa sasmitā sādhvī pādyaṃ jagrāha sādaram .. 24 ..
4.10.d:
पप्रच्छ कुशलं सा च गोपानां बालकस्य च ॥
उवास सस्मिता साध्वी पाद्यं जग्राह सादरम् ॥ 24 ॥

4.10.s:
tāmūcurgopikāḥ sarvāḥ kā tvamīśvari sāṃpratam ..
vāsaste kutra kiṃ nāma kiṃ vātra karma no vada .. 25 ..
4.10.d:
तामूचुर्गोपिकाः सर्वाः का त्वमीश्वरि सांप्रतम् ॥
वासस्ते कुत्र किं नाम किं वात्र कर्म नो वद ॥ 25 ॥

4.10.s:
tāsāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrutvā sāpyuvāca manoharam ..
mathurāvasinī gopī sāṃprataṃ viprakāminī .. 26 ..
4.10.d:
तासां च वचनं श्रुत्वा साप्युवाच मनोहरम् ॥
मथुरावसिनी गोपी सांप्रतं विप्रकामिनी ॥ 26 ॥

4.10.s:
śrutaṃ vācikavaktreṇa tattvaṃ maṃgalasūcakam ..
babhūva sthavire kāle naṃdaputro mahāniti .. 27 ..
4.10.d:
श्रुतं वाचिकवक्त्रेण तत्त्वं मंगलसूचकम् ॥
बभूव स्थविरे काले नंदपुत्रो महानिति ॥ 27 ॥

4.10.s:
śrutvāgatāhaṃ taṃ draṣṭumāśiṣaṃ kartumīpsitām .. .
putramānaya taṃ dṛṣṭvā yāmi kṛtvā tamāśiṣam .. 28 ..
4.10.d:
श्रुत्वागताहं तं द्रष्टुमाशिषं कर्तुमीप्सिताम् ॥ ।
पुत्रमानय तं दृष्ट्वा यामि कृत्वा तमाशिषम् ॥ 28 ॥

4.10.s:
brāhmaṇīvacanaṃ śrutvā yaśodā hṛṣṭamānasā ..
praṇamayya sutaṃ kroḍe dadau brāhmaṇayoṣitaḥ .. 29 ..
4.10.d:
ब्राह्मणीवचनं श्रुत्वा यशोदा हृष्टमानसा ॥
प्रणमय्य सुतं क्रोडे ददौ ब्राह्मणयोषितः ॥ 29 ॥

4.10.s:
kṛtvā kroḍe tu taṃ sādhvī cucuṃba ca punaḥ punaḥ ..
stanaṃ dadau sukhāsīnā hariṃ puṇyavatī satī .. .. 4.10.30 ..
4.10.d:
कृत्वा क्रोडे तु तं साध्वी चुचुंब च पुनः पुनः ॥
स्तनं ददौ सुखासीना हरिं पुण्यवती सती ॥ ॥ 4.10.30 ॥

4.10.s:
ahodbhuto'yaṃ bālasta sundaro gopasundari ..
guṇairnārāyaṇasamo bāloyamityuvāca ha .. 31 ..
4.10.d:
अहोद्भुतोऽयं बालस्त सुन्दरो गोपसुन्दरि ॥
गुणैर्नारायणसमो बालोयमित्युवाच ह ॥ 31 ॥

4.10.s:
kṛṣṇo viṣastanaṃ pītvā jahāsa vakṣasi sthitaḥ ..
tasyāḥ prāṇaiḥ saha papau viṣakṣīraṃ sudhāmiva .. 32 ..
4.10.d:
कृष्णो विषस्तनं पीत्वा जहास वक्षसि स्थितः ॥
तस्याः प्राणैः सह पपौ विषक्षीरं सुधामिव ॥ 32 ॥

4.10.s:
tatyāja bālakaṃ sādhvī prāṇāṃstyaktvā papāta ha ..
vikṛtākāravadanā cottānavadanā mune .. 33 ..
4.10.d:
तत्याज बालकं साध्वी प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा पपात ह ॥
विकृताकारवदना चोत्तानवदना मुने ॥ 33 ॥

4.10.s:
sthūladehaṃ parityajya sṛkṣmadehaṃ viveśa sā ..
āruroha rathaṃ śīghraṃ ratnasāravinirmitam .. 34 ..
4.10.d:
स्थूलदेहं परित्यज्य सृक्ष्मदेहं विवेश सा ॥
आरुरोह रथं शीघ्रं रत्नसारविनिर्मितम् ॥ 34 ॥

4.10.s:
pārṣadapravarairdivyairveṣṭitaṃ sumanoharaiḥ ..
śvetacāmaralakṣeṇa śobhitaṃ lakṣadarpaṇaiḥ .. 35 ..
4.10.d:
पार्षदप्रवरैर्दिव्यैर्वेष्टितं सुमनोहरैः ॥
श्वेतचामरलक्षेण शोभितं लक्षदर्पणैः ॥ 35 ॥

4.10.s:
vahniśaucena vastreṇa sūkṣmeṇa bhūṣitaṃ varam ..
nānācitravicitraiśca sadratnakalaśairyutam .. 36 ..
4.10.d:
वह्निशौचेन वस्त्रेण सूक्ष्मेण भूषितं वरम् ॥
नानाचित्रविचित्रैश्च सद्रत्नकलशैर्युतम् ॥ 36 ॥

4.10.s:
suṃdaraṃ śatacakraṃ ca valitaṃ ratnatejasā ..
pārṣadāstāṃ rathe kṛtvā jagmurgolokamuttamam .. 37 ..
4.10.d:
सुंदरं शतचक्रं च वलितं रत्नतेजसा ॥
पार्षदास्तां रथे कृत्वा जग्मुर्गोलोकमुत्तमम् ॥ 37 ॥

4.10.s:
dṛṣṭvā tamadbhutaṃ lokā gopikāścātivismitāḥ ..
kaṃsaḥ śrutvā ca tatsarvaṃ vismitaśca babhūva ha .. 38 ..
4.10.d:
दृष्ट्वा तमद्भुतं लोका गोपिकाश्चातिविस्मिताः ॥
कंसः श्रुत्वा च तत्सर्वं विस्मितश्च बभूव ह ॥ 38 ॥

4.10.s:
yaśodā bālakaṃ nītvā kroḍe kṛtvā stanaṃ dadau ..
maṃgalaṃ kārayāmāsa vipradvārā śiśormune .. 39 ..
4.10.d:
यशोदा बालकं नीत्वा क्रोडे कृत्वा स्तनं ददौ ॥
मंगलं कारयामास विप्रद्वारा शिशोर्मुने ॥ 39 ॥

4.10.s:
dadāha dehaṃ tasyāśca naṃdaḥ sānaṃdarpūvakam ..
caṃdanāgurukastūrīsamaṃ saṃprāpya saurabham .. 4.10.40 ..
4.10.d:
ददाह देहं तस्याश्च नंदः सानंदर्पूवकम् ॥
चंदनागुरुकस्तूरीसमं संप्राप्य सौरभम् ॥ 4.10.40 ॥

4.10.s:
nārada uvāca .. ..
sā vā kā rākṣasīrūpā kathaṃ puṇyavatī satī ..
kena puṇyena taṃ dṛṣṭvā jagāma kṛṣṇamaṃdiram .. 41 ..
4.10.d:
नारद उवाच ॥ ॥
सा वा का राक्षसीरूपा कथं पुण्यवती सती ॥
केन पुण्येन तं दृष्ट्वा जगाम कृष्णमंदिरम् ॥ 41 ॥

4.10.s:
.. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca .. ..
baliyajñe vāmanasya dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ manoharam..
balikanyā ratnamālā putrasnehaṃ cakāra tam .. 42 ..
4.10.d:
॥ श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥ ॥
बलियज्ञे वामनस्य दृष्ट्वा रूपं मनोहरम्॥
बलिकन्या रत्नमाला पुत्रस्नेहं चकार तम् ॥ 42 ॥

4.10.s:
manasā mānasaṃ cakre putrasya sadṛśo mama ..
pibedyadi stanaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ karomi taṃ ca vakṣasi .. 43 ..
4.10.d:
मनसा मानसं चक्रे पुत्रस्य सदृशो मम ॥
पिबेद्यदि स्तनं कृष्णः करोमि तं च वक्षसि ॥ 43 ॥

4.10.s:
haristanmānasaṃ jñātvā papau janmāṃtare stanam ..
dadau mātṛgatiṃ tasyai kāmapūraḥ kṛpānidhiḥ .. 44 ..
4.10.d:
हरिस्तन्मानसं ज्ञात्वा पपौ जन्मांतरे स्तनम् ॥
ददौ मातृगतिं तस्यै कामपूरः कृपानिधिः ॥ 44 ॥
4.10.m:
Hari, knowing her mind, drank her breast in another birth;
the fulfiller of desires, the ocean of mercy, gave her the destination of a mother.

4.10.s:
dattvā viṣastanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pūtanā rākṣasī mune ..
bhaktyā mātṛgatiṃ prāpa kaṃ bhajāma vinā harim .. 45 ..
4.10.d:
दत्त्वा विषस्तनं कृष्णं पूतना राक्षसी मुने ॥
भक्त्या मातृगतिं प्राप कं भजाम विना हरिम् ॥ 45 ॥
4.10.m:
Having given her poisoned breast to Kṛṣṇa, the rākṣasī Pūtanā, O sage,
attained the destination of a mother through devotion; whom else should we worship other than Hari?

4.10.s:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vipra śrīkṛṣṇa guṇakīrtanam ..
padepade sumadhuraṃ pravaraṃ kathayāmi te..46..
4.10.d:
इत्येवं कथितं विप्र श्रीकृष्ण गुणकीर्तनम् ॥
पदेपदे सुमधुरं प्रवरं कथयामि ते॥46॥
4.10.m:
Thus the praise of Śrī Kṛṣṇa's virtues has been told, O brāhmaṇa;
I shall tell you that which is foremost and exceedingly sweet at every step.

4.11.s:
.. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
ekadā gokule sādhvī yaśodā naṃdagehinī ..
gṛhakarmaṇi saṃsaktā kṛtvā bālaṃ svavakṣasi .. 1 ..
4.11.d:
॥ श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
एकदा गोकुले साध्वी यशोदा नंदगेहिनी ॥
गृहकर्मणि संसक्ता कृत्वा बालं स्ववक्षसि ॥ 1 ॥

4.11.s:
vātyārūpaṃ tṛṇāvartamāgacchaṃtaṃ ca gokulam ..
śrīharirmanasā jñātvā bhārayukto babhūva ha.. 2 ..
4.11.d:
वात्यारूपं तृणावर्तमागच्छंतं च गोकुलम् ॥
श्रीहरिर्मनसा ज्ञात्वा भारयुक्तो बभूव ह॥ 2 ॥

4.11.s:
bhārākrāṃtā yaśodā ca tatyāja bālakaṃ tadā ..
śayanaṃ kārayitvā ca jagāma yamunāṃ mune .. 3 ..
4.11.d:
भाराक्रांता यशोदा च तत्याज बालकं तदा ॥
शयनं कारयित्वा च जगाम यमुनां मुने ॥ 3 ॥

4.11.s:
etasminnaṃtare ta vātyārūpadharo'suraḥ ..
ādāya taṃ bhrāmayitvā gatvā ca śatayojanam .. 4 ..
4.11.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे त वात्यारूपधरोऽसुरः ॥
आदाय तं भ्रामयित्वा गत्वा च शतयोजनम् ॥ 4 ॥

4.11.s:
babhaṃja vṛkṣaśākhāśca hyaṃdhībhūtaṃ ca gokulam ..
cakāra sadyo māyāvī punastatra papāta ha .. 5 ..
4.11.d:
बभंज वृक्षशाखाश्च ह्यंधीभूतं च गोकुलम् ॥
चकार सद्यो मायावी पुनस्तत्र पपात ह ॥ 5 ॥

4.11.s:
asuro'pi harisparśājjagāma harimaṃdiram ..
suṃdaraṃ rathamāruhya kṛtvā karmakṣayaṃ svakam .. 6 ..
4.11.d:
असुरोऽपि हरिस्पर्शाज्जगाम हरिमंदिरम् ॥
सुंदरं रथमारुह्य कृत्वा कर्मक्षयं स्वकम् ॥ 6 ॥

4.11.s:
pāṃḍyadeśodbhavo rājā śāpāddurvāsaso'suraḥ ..
śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇasparśādgolokaṃ sa jagāma ha .. 7 ..
4.11.d:
पांड्यदेशोद्भवो राजा शापाद्दुर्वाससोऽसुरः ॥
श्रीकृष्णचरणस्पर्शाद्गोलोकं स जगाम ह ॥ 7 ॥

4.11.s:
vātyārūpe gate gopā gopyaśca bhayavihvalāḥ ..
na dṛṣṭvā bālakaṃ tatra śayānaṃ śayane mune.. 8 ..
4.11.d:
वात्यारूपे गते गोपा गोप्यश्च भयविह्वलाः ॥
न दृष्ट्वा बालकं तत्र शयानं शयने मुने॥ 8 ॥

4.11.s:
sarve nijaghnuḥ svaṃ vakṣasthalaṃ śokākulā bhayāt ..
kecinmūrchāmavāpuśca ruruduścāpi kecana .. 9 ..
4.11.d:
सर्वे निजघ्नुः स्वं वक्षस्थलं शोकाकुला भयात् ॥
केचिन्मूर्छामवापुश्च रुरुदुश्चापि केचन ॥ 9 ॥

4.11.s:
anveṣaṇaṃ prakurvaṃto dadṛśurbālakaṃ vraje ..
dhūlidhūsarasarvāṃgaṃ puṣpodyānāṃtarasthitam .. 4.11.10 ..
4.11.d:
अन्वेषणं प्रकुर्वंतो ददृशुर्बालकं व्रजे ॥
धूलिधूसरसर्वांगं पुष्पोद्यानांतरस्थितम् ॥ 4.11.10 ॥

4.11.s:
bāhyaikadeśe sarasastīre nīrasamanvite ..
paśyaṃtaṃ gaganaṃ śaśvadvadaṃtaṃ bhayakātaram .. 11 ..
4.11.d:
बाह्यैकदेशे सरसस्तीरे नीरसमन्विते ॥
पश्यंतं गगनं शश्वद्वदंतं भयकातरम् ॥ 11 ॥

4.11.s:
gṛhītvā bālakaṃ naṃdaḥ kṛtvā vakṣasi satvaram ..
darśaṃ darśaṃ mukhaṃ tasya ruroda ca śucā'nvitaḥ .. 12 ..
4.11.d:
गृहीत्वा बालकं नंदः कृत्वा वक्षसि सत्वरम् ॥
दर्शं दर्शं मुखं तस्य रुरोद च शुचाऽन्वितः ॥ 12 ॥

4.11.s:
yaśodā rohiṇī śīghraṃ dṛṣṭvā bālaṃ ruroda ca ..
kṛtvā vakṣasi tadvaktraṃ cucuṃba ca muhurmuhuḥ .. 13 ..
4.11.d:
यशोदा रोहिणी शीघ्रं दृष्ट्वा बालं रुरोद च ॥
कृत्वा वक्षसि तद्वक्त्रं चुचुंब च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥ 13 ॥

4.11.s:
maṃgalaṃ kārayāmāsa snāpayāmāsa bālakam ..
stanaṃ dadau yaśodā ca prasannavadanekṣaṇā .. 14 ..
4.11.d:
मंगलं कारयामास स्नापयामास बालकम् ॥
स्तनं ददौ यशोदा च प्रसन्नवदनेक्षणा ॥ 14 ॥

4.11.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
kathaṃ śaśāpa durvāsāḥ pāṃḍyadeśodbhavaṃ nṛpam ..
suvicārya vada brahmannitihāsaṃ purātanam .. 15 ..
4.11.d:
॥ नारद उवाच ॥ ॥
कथं शशाप दुर्वासाः पांड्यदेशोद्भवं नृपम् ॥
सुविचार्य वद ब्रह्मन्नितिहासं पुरातनम् ॥ 15 ॥

4.11.s:
.. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca .. ..
pāṃḍyadeśādhipo rājā sahasrākṣaḥ pratāpavān ..
strīsahasraṃ samādāya kāmabāṇaprapīḍitaḥ .. 16 ..
4.11.d:
॥ श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥ ॥
पांड्यदेशाधिपो राजा सहस्राक्षः प्रतापवान् ॥
स्त्रीसहस्रं समादाय कामबाणप्रपीडितः ॥ 16 ॥

4.11.s:
manohare nirjane ca parvate gaṃdhamādane ..
vijahāra nadītīre puṣpodyāne manorame .. 17 ..
4.11.d:
मनोहरे निर्जने च पर्वते गंधमादने ॥
विजहार नदीतीरे पुष्पोद्याने मनोरमे ॥ 17 ॥

4.11.s:
nānāprakāraśṛgāraṃ viparītādikaṃ nṛpaḥ ..
nakhadaṃtakṣatāṃgaṃ ca kāminīnāṃ cakāra saḥ .. 18 ..
4.11.d:
नानाप्रकारशृगारं विपरीतादिकं नृपः ॥
नखदंतक्षतांगं च कामिनीनां चकार सः ॥ 18 ॥
4.11.m: he wounded the bodies of the passionate women with his nails and teeth. (18)

4.11.s:
kṛtvā mūrtisahasraṃ ca yogīṃdro nṛpatīśvaraḥ ..
kṛtvā sthalavihāraṃ ca jalakrīḍāṃ cakāra ha .. 19 ..
4.11.d:
कृत्वा मूर्तिसहस्रं च योगींद्रो नृपतीश्वरः ॥
कृत्वा स्थलविहारं च जलक्रीडां चकार ह ॥ 19 ॥
4.11.m:
Creating a thousand forms, that supreme yogin and ruler of kings
enjoyed diversions on land and made sport in the water. (19)

4.11.s:
nāryo vivasanāḥ sarvā nagnāśca nṛpayoṣitaḥ ..
vijahruśca puṣpabhadrānadītīre manohare .. 4.11.20 ..
4.11.d:
नार्यो विवसनाः सर्वा नग्नाश्च नृपयोषितः ॥
विजह्रुश्च पुष्पभद्रानदीतीरे मनोहरे ॥ 4.11.20 ॥
4.11.m:
All the women were unclothed; the king's wives were naked,
and they sported on the charming bank of the Puṣpabhadrā river. (20)

4.11.s:
etasminnaṃtare tatra samāyāto mahāmuniḥ ..
śiṣyalakṣaiḥ parivṛto gacchanvai śaṃkaraṃ prati .. 21 ..
4.11.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तत्र समायातो महामुनिः ॥
शिष्यलक्षैः परिवृतो गच्छन्वै शंकरं प्रति ॥ 21 ॥
4.11.m:
Meanwhile, the great sage arrived there,
surrounded by a hundred thousand disciples, on his way toward Śaṅkara. (21)

4.11.s:
dṛṣṭvā muniṃ mahāmatto nottasthau na nanāma ha ..
vācā hastena rājā ca saṃbhāṣāṃ na cakāra ha .. 22 ..
4.11.d:
दृष्ट्वा मुनिं महामत्तो नोत्तस्थौ न ननाम ह ॥
वाचा हस्तेन राजा च संभाषां न चकार ह ॥ 22 ॥
4.11.m:
Seeing the sage, the king, exceedingly intoxicated, did not rise up nor did he bow;
he did not address him with words or acknowledge him with his hand. (22)

4.11.s:
dṛṣṭvā cukopa nṛpatiṃ śaśāpa sphuritādharaḥ ..
asuro bhava pāpiṣṭha yogādbhraṣṭo bhuvaṃ vraja ..23 ..
4.11.d:
दृष्ट्वा चुकोप नृपतिं शशाप स्फुरिताधरः ॥
असुरो भव पापिष्ठ योगाद्भ्रष्टो भुवं व्रज ॥23 ॥
4.11.m:
Seeing him, [the sage] was enraged at the king and cursed him, his lower lip quivering:
“Become an asura, most wicked one! Fallen from yoga, go down to earth! (23)

4.11.s:
bhārate lakṣavarṣaṃ ca sthātavyaṃ te narādhama ..
tato haripadasparśādgolokaṃ yāsyasi dhruvam .. 24 ..
4.11.d:
भारते लक्षवर्षं च स्थातव्यं ते नराधम ॥
ततो हरिपदस्पर्शाद्गोलोकं यास्यसि ध्रुवम् ॥ 24 ॥
4.11.m:
You must remain in Bhārata for a hundred thousand years, lowest of men;
then, from the touch of Hari's feet, you will surely go to Goloka! (24)

4.11.s:
sthānesthāne he mahiṣyo janiṃ labhata bhārate ..
rājeṃdragehe rājeṃdrādbhaviṣyatha manoharāḥ .. 25 ..
4.11.d:
स्थानेस्थाने हे महिष्यो जनिं लभत भारते ॥
राजेंद्रगेहे राजेंद्राद्भविष्यथ मनोहराः ॥ 25 ॥
4.11.m:
O queens, take birth in various places in Bhārata!
In the house of a supreme king, born from a supreme king, you will be lovely!” (25)

4.11.s:
ityuktvā tu munīṃdrastu jagāma śaṃkarālayam ..
hā hā śabdaṃ vicakruśca śiṣyasaṃghāḥ kṛpālavaḥ .. 26 ..
4.11.d:
इत्युक्त्वा तु मुनींद्रस्तु जगाम शंकरालयम् ॥
हा हा शब्दं विचक्रुश्च शिष्यसंघाः कृपालवः ॥ 26 ॥
4.11.m:
Having spoken thus, the lord of sages went to the abode of Śaṅkara,
while the hosts of compassionate disciples cried out, “Alas, alas!” (26)

4.11.s:
gate munīṃdre rājeṃdro ruroda ca sarittaṭe ..
rurudū ramaṇīyāśca ramaṇyo virahāturāḥ .. .. 27 ..
4.11.d:
गते मुनींद्रे राजेंद्रो रुरोद च सरित्तटे ॥
रुरुदू रमणीयाश्च रमण्यो विरहातुराः ॥ ॥ 27 ॥
4.11.m:
When the lord of sages had departed, the supreme king wept on the riverbank,
and the charming women wept, afflicted by separation. (27)

4.11.s:
he nātha ramaṇaśreṣṭhetyuccārya ca punaḥ punaḥ ..
tvāṃ vinā vā kva yāsyāmo vayaṃ tvaṃ vā kva yāsyasi.. 28 ..
4.11.d:
हे नाथ रमणश्रेष्ठेत्युच्चार्य च पुनः पुनः ॥
त्वां विना वा क्व यास्यामो वयं त्वं वा क्व यास्यसि॥ 28 ॥
4.11.m:
Uttering repeatedly, “O lord, best of lovers,
where shall we go without you, or where will you go? (28)

4.11.s:
vayaṃ no vihariṣyāmastvayā sārddhaṃ sunirjane ..
na kariṣyasi rājyaṃ tvaṃ na yāsyāmo gṛhaṃ vayam .. 29 ..
4.11.d:
वयं नो विहरिष्यामस्त्वया सार्द्धं सुनिर्जने ॥
न करिष्यसि राज्यं त्वं न यास्यामो गृहं वयम् ॥ 29 ॥
4.11.m:
We shall no longer sport with you in deep solitude;
you will not rule the kingdom, and we will not go home! (29)

4.11.s:
śaraccaṃdraprabhāmuṣṭaṃ na drakṣyāmo mukhaṃ tava ..
prasāritābhyāṃ bāhubhyāṃ nānayiṣyāma ityataḥ ..4.11.30..
4.11.d:
शरच्चंद्रप्रभामुष्टं न द्रक्ष्यामो मुखं तव ॥
प्रसारिताभ्यां बाहुभ्यां नानयिष्याम इत्यतः ॥4.11.30॥
4.11.m:
We shall no longer behold your face that surpasses the radiance of the autumn moon,
nor will we embrace you with outstretched arms from now on!” (30)

4.11.s:
ityuktvā ruruduḥ sarvāḥ puraskṛtya narādhipam ..
mūrchāmavāpuścaraṇaṃ dhṛtvā rājñaḥ sarittaṭe .. 31 ..
4.11.d:
इत्युक्त्वा रुरुदुः सर्वाः पुरस्कृत्य नराधिपम् ॥
मूर्छामवापुश्चरणं धृत्वा राज्ञः सरित्तटे ॥ 31 ॥
4.11.m:
Having spoken thus, facing the ruler of men, they all wept;
clasping the king's feet on the riverbank, they fell into a faint. (31)

4.11.s:
rājā'gnikuṇḍamādhāya nārībhiḥ saha nārada ..
smṛtvā haripadāṃbhojaṃ jvaladagniṃ viveśa ha ..32..
4.11.d:
राजाऽग्निकुण्डमाधाय नारीभिः सह नारद ॥
स्मृत्वा हरिपदांभोजं ज्वलदग्निं विवेश ह ॥32॥
4.11.m:
The king, having prepared a fire-pit together with the women, O Nārada,
remembered the lotus feet of Hari and entered the blazing fire. (32)

4.11.s:
hāhākāraṃ surāḥ sarve vicakrurgagane sthitāḥ..
ityūcurmunayaścaiva daivaṃ ca balavattaram..33..
4.11.d:
हाहाकारं सुराः सर्वे विचक्रुर्गगने स्थिताः॥
इत्यूचुर्मुनयश्चैव दैवं च बलवत्तरम्॥33॥
4.11.m:
All the gods standing in the sky cried out, “Alas, alas!”
And the sages said, “Destiny is indeed all-powerful.” (33)

4.11.s:
sa ca rājā tṛṇāvarto jagāma harimaṃdiram..
mahiṣyo bhārate varṣe lebhire janma vāñchitam .. 34 ..
4.11.d:
स च राजा तृणावर्तो जगाम हरिमंदिरम्॥
महिष्यो भारते वर्षे लेभिरे जन्म वाञ्छितम् ॥ 34 ॥
4.11.m:
And that king, [born as] Tṛṇāvarta, went to the abode of Hari;
the queens obtained their desired birth in the land of Bhārata. (34)

4.11.s:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ harermāhātmya muttamam ..
mākṣaṇaṃ nṛpateścaiva munīṃdraśāpahetukam .. 35 ..
4.11.d:
इत्येवं कथितं सर्वं हरेर्माहात्म्य मुत्तमम् ॥
माक्षणं नृपतेश्चैव मुनींद्रशापहेतुकम् ॥ 35 ॥
4.11.m: and the king's release caused by the curse of the lord of sages. (35)

4.12.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca .. ..
ekadā maṃdire nandapatnī sā''naṃdapūrvakam ..
kṛtvā vakṣasi goviṃdaṃ kṣudhitaṃ ca stanaṃ dadau .. 1 ..
4.12.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥ ॥
एकदा मंदिरे नन्दपत्नी सा'ऽनंदपूर्वकम् ॥
कृत्वा वक्षसि गोविंदं क्षुधितं च स्तनं ददौ ॥ 1 ॥

4.12.s:
etasminnaṃtare gopya ājagmurnaṃdamaṃdiram ..
sthavirāśca vayasyāśca bālikā bālakānvitāḥ .. 2 ..
4.12.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे गोप्य आजग्मुर्नंदमंदिरम् ॥
स्थविराश्च वयस्याश्च बालिका बालकान्विताः ॥ 2 ॥

4.12.s:
atṛptaṃ bālakaṃ śīghraṃ saṃnyasya śayane satī ..
praṇanāma samutthāya karmaṇyautthānike mudā .. 3 ..
4.12.d:
अतृप्तं बालकं शीघ्रं संन्यस्य शयने सती ॥
प्रणनाम समुत्थाय कर्मण्यौत्थानिके मुदा ॥ 3 ॥

4.12.s:
tailasiṃdūratāṃbūlaṃ dadau tābhyo mudā'nvitā..
miṣṭavastūni vastrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni ca gopikā .. 4 ..
4.12.d:
तैलसिंदूरतांबूलं ददौ ताभ्यो मुदाऽन्विता॥
मिष्टवस्तूनि वस्त्राणि भूषणानि च गोपिका ॥ 4 ॥
4.12.m: sweet dishes, garments, and ornaments. (4)

4.12.s:
etasminnantare kṛṣṇo ruroda kṣudhitastadā ..
prerayitvā sa caraṇaṃ māyeśo māyayā vibhuḥ ..5..
4.12.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे कृष्णो रुरोद क्षुधितस्तदा ॥
प्रेरयित्वा स चरणं मायेशो मायया विभुः ॥5॥

4.12.s:
papāta caraṇaṃ tasya pravīṇe śakaṭe mune ..
viśvaṃbharapadāghātāttacca cūrṇaṃ babhūva ha .. 6 ..
4.12.d:
पपात चरणं तस्य प्रवीणे शकटे मुने ॥
विश्वंभरपदाघातात्तच्च चूर्णं बभूव ह ॥ 6 ॥

4.12.s:
babhaṃja śakaṭaṃ peturbhagnakāṣṭhāni tatra vai ..
papāta dadhi dugdhaṃ ca navanītaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu ..7..
4.12.d:
बभंज शकटं पेतुर्भग्नकाष्ठानि तत्र वै ॥
पपात दधि दुग्धं च नवनीतं घृतं मधु ॥7॥

4.12.s:
dṛṣṭvā''ścaryaṃ gopikāśca dudruvurbālakaṃ bhayāt..
dadṛśurbhagnaśakaṭamiṃdhanābhyaṃtare śiśum..8..
4.12.d:
दृष्ट्वा'ऽश्चर्यं गोपिकाश्च दुद्रुवुर्बालकं भयात्॥
ददृशुर्भग्नशकटमिंधनाभ्यंतरे शिशुम्॥8॥

4.12.s:
bhagnabhāṃḍasamūhaṃ ca patitaṃ bahugorasam ..
prerayitvā tu kāṣṭhāni jagrāha bālakaṃ bhiyā .. 9 ..
4.12.d:
भग्नभांडसमूहं च पतितं बहुगोरसम् ॥
प्रेरयित्वा तु काष्ठानि जग्राह बालकं भिया ॥ 9 ॥

4.12.s:
māyārakṣitasarvāṃgaṃ ruditaṃ kṣudhitaṃ kṣudhā..
stanaṃ dadau yaśodā taṃ ruroda ca bhṛśaṃ śucā .. 4.12.10 ..
4.12.d:
मायारक्षितसर्वांगं रुदितं क्षुधितं क्षुधा॥
स्तनं ददौ यशोदा तं रुरोद च भृशं शुचा ॥ 4.12.10 ॥

4.12.s:
papracchurbālakāngopā babhaṃja śakaṭaṃ katham ..
kiṃciddhetuṃ na paśyāmaḥ sahaseti kimadbhutam .. 11 ..
4.12.d:
पप्रच्छुर्बालकान्गोपा बभंज शकटं कथम् ॥
किंचिद्धेतुं न पश्यामः सहसेति किमद्भुतम् ॥ 11 ॥

4.12.s:
ityūcurbālakāḥ sarve gopāḥ śṛṇuta madvacaḥ ..
śrīkṛṣṇasya padāghātādbabhaṃja śakaṭaṃ dhruvam ..12..
4.12.d:
इत्यूचुर्बालकाः सर्वे गोपाः शृणुत मद्वचः ॥
श्रीकृष्णस्य पदाघाताद्बभंज शकटं ध्रुवम् ॥12॥

4.12.s:
śrutvā tadvacanaṃ gopā gopyaśca jahasurmudā ..
na hi jagmuḥ pratītiṃ ca mithyetyūcurvraje prajāḥ .. 13 ..
4.12.d:
श्रुत्वा तद्वचनं गोपा गोप्यश्च जहसुर्मुदा ॥
न हि जग्मुः प्रतीतिं च मिथ्येत्यूचुर्व्रजे प्रजाः ॥ 13 ॥

4.12.s:
śiśoḥ svastyayanaṃ kāryaṃ cakrurbrāhmaṇapuṃgavāḥ ..
hastaṃ dattvā śiśorgātre papāṭha kavacaṃ dvijaḥ .. 14 ..
4.12.d:
शिशोः स्वस्त्ययनं कार्यं चक्रुर्ब्राह्मणपुंगवाः ॥
हस्तं दत्त्वा शिशोर्गात्रे पपाठ कवचं द्विजः ॥ 14 ॥

4.12.s:
vadāmi tatte viprendra kavacaṃ sarvarakṣaṇam ..
yaddattaṃ māyayā pūrvaṃ brahmaṇe nābhipaṃkaje ..15..
4.12.d:
वदामि तत्ते विप्रेन्द्र कवचं सर्वरक्षणम् ॥
यद्दत्तं मायया पूर्वं ब्रह्मणे नाभिपंकजे ॥15॥

4.12.s:
nidrite jagatīnāthe jale ca jalaśāyini ..
bhītāya stutikartre ca madhukaiṭabhayorbhayāt .. 16 ..
4.12.d:
निद्रिते जगतीनाथे जले च जलशायिनि ॥
भीताय स्तुतिकर्त्रे च मधुकैटभयोर्भयात् ॥ 16 ॥

4.12.s:
yoganidrovāca ..
dūrībhūtaṃ kuru bhayaṃ bhayaṃ kiṃ te harau sthite ..
sthitāyāṃ mayi ca brahmansukhī tiṣṭha jagatpate ..17..
4.12.d:
योगनिद्रोवाच ॥
दूरीभूतं कुरु भयं भयं किं ते हरौ स्थिते ॥
स्थितायां मयि च ब्रह्मन्सुखी तिष्ठ जगत्पते ॥17॥

4.12.s:
śrīhariḥ pātu te vaktraṃ mastakaṃ madhusūdanaḥ ..
śrīkṛṣṇaścakṣuṣī pātu nāsikāṃ rādhikāpatiḥ .. 18 ..
4.12.d:
श्रीहरिः पातु ते वक्त्रं मस्तकं मधुसूदनः ॥
श्रीकृष्णश्चक्षुषी पातु नासिकां राधिकापतिः ॥ 18 ॥

4.12.s:
karṇayugmaṃ ca kaṇṭhaṃ ca kapālaṃ pātu mādhavaḥ ..
kapolaṃ pātu govindaḥ keśāṃśca keśavaḥ svayam ..19..
4.12.d:
कर्णयुग्मं च कण्ठं च कपालं पातु माधवः ॥
कपोलं पातु गोविन्दः केशांश्च केशवः स्वयम् ॥19॥

4.12.s:
adharoṣṭhaṃ hṛṣīkeśo daṃtapaṃktiṃ gadāgrajaḥ ..
rāseśvaraśca rasanāṃ tālukaṃ vāmano vibhuḥ .. 4.12.20 ..
4.12.d:
अधरोष्ठं हृषीकेशो दंतपंक्तिं गदाग्रजः ॥
रासेश्वरश्च रसनां तालुकं वामनो विभुः ॥ 4.12.20 ॥
4.12.m:
may Hṛṣīkeśa protect the lower lip; may the elder brother of Gada protect the row of teeth;
may the Lord of the Rāsa protect the tongue; may the all-pervading Vāmana protect the palate; // 4.12.20

4.12.s:
vakṣaḥ pātu mukundaśca jaṭharaṃ pātu daityahā ..
janārdanaḥ pātu nābhiṃ pātu viṣṇuśca mehanam .. 21 ..
4.12.d:
वक्षः पातु मुकुन्दश्च जठरं पातु दैत्यहा ॥
जनार्दनः पातु नाभिं पातु विष्णुश्च मेहनम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.12.m:
may Mukunda protect the chest; may the slayer of Daityas protect the belly;
may Janārdana protect the navel; and may Viṣṇu protect the male organ; // 21

4.12.s:
nitaṃbayugmaṃ guhyaṃ ca pātu te puruṣottamaḥ ..
jānuyugme jānakīśaḥ pātu te sarvadā vibhuḥ .. 22 ..
4.12.d:
नितंबयुग्मं गुह्यं च पातु ते पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
जानुयुग्मे जानकीशः पातु ते सर्वदा विभुः ॥ 22 ॥
4.12.m:
may Puruṣottama protect both buttocks and the private parts;
may the all-pervading Lord of Jānakī always protect both your knees; // 22

4.12.s:
hastayugmaṃ nṛsiṃhaśca pātu sarvatra saṃkaṭe ..
pādayugmaṃ varāhaśca pātu te kamalodbhavaḥ .. 23 ..
4.12.d:
हस्तयुग्मं नृसिंहश्च पातु सर्वत्र संकटे ॥
पादयुग्मं वराहश्च पातु ते कमलोद्भवः ॥ 23 ॥
4.12.m:
may Nṛsiṃha protect both hands everywhere in difficulty;
may Varāha protect both feet, O lotus-born one! // 23

4.12.s:
ūrdhvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ pātu hyadhastātkamalāpatiḥ ..
pūrvasyāṃ pātu gopālaḥ pātu vahnau daśāsyahā .. 24 ..
4.12.d:
ऊर्ध्वं नारायणः पातु ह्यधस्तात्कमलापतिः ॥
पूर्वस्यां पातु गोपालः पातु वह्नौ दशास्यहा ॥ 24 ॥
4.12.m:
May Nārāyaṇa protect above, and indeed may the husband of Kamalā protect below;
may Gopāla protect in the east; may the slayer of the ten-faced one protect in the southeast; // 24

4.12.s:
vanamālī pātu yāmyāṃ vaikuṃṭhaḥ pātu nairṛtau ..
vāruṇyāṃ vāsudevaśca sato rakṣākaraḥ svayam .. 25 ..
4.12.d:
वनमाली पातु याम्यां वैकुंठः पातु नैरृतौ ॥
वारुण्यां वासुदेवश्च सतो रक्षाकरः स्वयम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.12.m:
may Vanamālin protect in the south; may Vaikuṇṭha protect in the southwest;
may Vāsudeva himself, the protector of the virtuous, protect in the west; // 25

4.12.s:
pātu te saṃtatamajo vāyavyāṃ viṣṭaraśravāḥ ..
uttare ca sadā pātu tejasā jalajāsanaḥ .. 26 ..
4.12.d:
पातु ते संततमजो वायव्यां विष्टरश्रवाः ॥
उत्तरे च सदा पातु तेजसा जलजासनः ॥ 26 ॥
4.12.m:
may the unborn Viṣṭaraśravas protect you continually in the northwest;
and in the north, may he who sits upon the lotus ever protect with splendour; // 26

4.12.s:
aiśānyāmīśvaraḥ pātu pātu sarvatra śatrujit ..
jale sthale cāṃtarikṣe nidrāyāṃ pātu rāghavaḥ .. 27 ..
4.12.d:
ऐशान्यामीश्वरः पातु पातु सर्वत्र शत्रुजित् ॥
जले स्थले चांतरिक्षे निद्रायां पातु राघवः ॥ 27 ॥
4.12.m:
may the Lord protect in the northeast; may the conqueror of enemies protect everywhere;
on water, on land, in the mid-region, and in sleep, may Rāghava protect! // 27

4.12.s:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ brahmankavacaṃ paramādbhutam ..
kṛṣṇena kṛpayā dattaṃ smṛtenaiva purā mayā .. 28 ..
4.12.d:
इत्येवं कथितं ब्रह्मन्कवचं परमाद्भुतम् ॥
कृष्णेन कृपया दत्तं स्मृतेनैव पुरा मया ॥ 28 ॥
4.12.m:
Thus has been spoken, O Brahman, the most wondrous armour,
graciously given of old by Kṛṣṇa when I merely remembered him. // 28

4.12.s:
śuṃbhena saha saṃgrāme nirlakṣye ghoradāruṇe ..
gagane sthitayā sadyaḥ prāptimātreṇa so jitaḥ .. 29 ..
4.12.d:
शुंभेन सह संग्रामे निर्लक्ष्ये घोरदारुणे ॥
गगने स्थितया सद्यः प्राप्तिमात्रेण सो जितः ॥ 29 ॥
4.12.m:
In the battle with Śumbha, unseen and exceedingly fierce,
standing in the sky, he was defeated as soon as [this] was obtained by me. // 29

4.12.s:
kavacasya prabhāveṇa dharaṇyāṃ patito mṛtaḥ..
pūrvaṃ varṣaśataṃ khe ca kṛtvā yuddhaṃ bhayāvaham .. 4.12.30 ..
4.12.d:
कवचस्य प्रभावेण धरण्यां पतितो मृतः॥
पूर्वं वर्षशतं खे च कृत्वा युद्धं भयावहम् ॥ 4.12.30 ॥
4.12.m:
By the power of the armour, he fell dead upon the earth,
after previously fighting a terrifying battle in the sky for a hundred years. // 4.12.30

4.12.s:
mṛte śuṃbhe ca govindaḥ kṛpālurgaganasthitaḥ ..
mālāṃ ca kavacaṃ dattvā golokaṃ sa jagāma ha .. 31 ..
4.12.d:
मृते शुंभे च गोविन्दः कृपालुर्गगनस्थितः ॥
मालां च कवचं दत्त्वा गोलोकं स जगाम ह ॥ 31 ॥
4.12.m:
When Śumbha was slain, compassionate Govinda, standing in the sky,
gave the garland and the armour, and departed to Goloka. // 31

4.12.s:
kalpāṃtarasya vṛttāṃtaṃ kṛpayā kathitaṃ mune ..
abhyaṃtarabhayaṃ nāsti kavacasya prabhāvataḥ .. 32 ..
4.12.d:
कल्पांतरस्य वृत्तांतं कृपया कथितं मुने ॥
अभ्यंतरभयं नास्ति कवचस्य प्रभावतः ॥ 32 ॥
4.12.m:
The account of another kalpa has been graciously spoken, O sage;
there is no internal fear through the power of this armour. // 32

4.12.s:
koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo naṣṭā mayā dṛṣṭāśca vedhasaḥ ..
ahaṃ ca hariṇā sārddhaṃ kalpekalpe sthirā sadā .. 33 ..
4.12.d:
कोटिशः कोटिशो नष्टा मया दृष्टाश्च वेधसः ॥
अहं च हरिणा सार्द्धं कल्पेकल्पे स्थिरा सदा ॥ 33 ॥
4.12.m:
Millions upon millions of Brahmās have been seen destroyed by me,
while I, together with Hari, remain forever steadfast in kalpa after kalpa." // 33

4.12.s:
ityuktvā kavacaṃ dattvā sā'ntardhānaṃ cakāra ha ..
niḥśaṅko nābhikamale tasthau sa kamalodbhavaḥ .. 34 ..
4.12.d:
इत्युक्त्वा कवचं दत्त्वा साऽन्तर्धानं चकार ह ॥
निःशङ्को नाभिकमले तस्थौ स कमलोद्भवः ॥ 34 ॥
4.12.m:
Having spoken thus and granted the armour, she vanished.
The lotus-born one remained fearless on the navel-lotus. // 34

4.12.s:
suvarṇaguṭikāyāṃ ca kṛtvedaṃ kavacaṃ param ..
kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau badhnīyādyaḥ sudhīḥ sadā .. 35 ..
4.12.d:
सुवर्णगुटिकायां च कृत्वेदं कवचं परम् ॥
कण्ठे वा दक्षिणे बाहौ बध्नीयाद्यः सुधीः सदा ॥ 35 ॥
4.12.m:
Having placed this supreme armour inside a golden amulet,
whichever wise person constantly binds it on the neck or on the right arm, // 35

4.12.s:
viṣāgnijalaśatrubhyo bhayaṃ tasya na jāyate ..
jale sthale cāṃtarikṣe nidrāyāṃ rakṣatīśvaraḥ .. 36 ..
4.12.d:
विषाग्निजलशत्रुभ्यो भयं तस्य न जायते ॥
जले स्थले चांतरिक्षे निद्रायां रक्षतीश्वरः ॥ 36 ॥
4.12.m:
no fear arises for him from poison, fire, water, or enemies.
On water, on land, in the mid-region, and in sleep, the Lord protects [him]. // 36

4.12.s:
saṃgrāme vajrapāte ca vipattau prāṇasaṃkaṭe ..
kavacasmaraṇādeva sadyo niḥśaṅkatāṃ vrajet .. 37 ..
4.12.d:
संग्रामे वज्रपाते च विपत्तौ प्राणसंकटे ॥
कवचस्मरणादेव सद्यो निःशङ्कतां व्रजेत् ॥ 37 ॥
4.12.m:
In battle, during a stroke of lightning, in misfortune, or in mortal danger,
simply by remembering this armour one immediately becomes free from fear. // 37

4.12.s:
baddhvedaṃ kavacaṃ kaṇṭhe śaṃkarastripuraṃ purā ..
jaghāna līlāmātreṇa duraṃtamasureśvaram .. 38 ..
4.12.d:
बद्ध्वेदं कवचं कण्ठे शंकरस्त्रिपुरं पुरा ॥
जघान लीलामात्रेण दुरंतमसुरेश्वरम् ॥ 38 ॥
4.12.m:
Having bound this armour around his neck in ancient times, Śaṅkara
slew the insurmountable lord of the asuras, Tripura, merely in sport. // 38

4.12.s:
baddhvedaṃ kavacaṃ kālī raktabījaṃ cakhāda sā ..
sahasraśīrṣā dhṛtvedaṃ viśvaṃ dhatte tilaṃ yathā .. 39 ..
4.12.d:
बद्ध्वेदं कवचं काली रक्तबीजं चखाद सा ॥
सहस्रशीर्षा धृत्वेदं विश्वं धत्ते तिलं यथा ॥ 39 ॥
4.12.m:
Having bound this armour, Kālī devoured Raktabīja.
Having donned this, the thousand-headed [Śeṣa] upholds the universe like a sesame seed. // 39

4.12.s:
āvāṃ sanatkumāraśca dharmasākṣī ca karmaṇām ..
kavacasya prabhāveṇa sarvatra jayino vayam .. 4.12.40 ..
4.12.d:
आवां सनत्कुमारश्च धर्मसाक्षी च कर्मणाम् ॥
कवचस्य प्रभावेण सर्वत्र जयिनो वयम् ॥ 4.12.40 ॥
4.12.m:
The two of us, Sanatkumāra, and Dharma the witness of deeds—
by the power of this armour we are victorious everywhere. // 4.12.40

4.12.s:
tasya nandaśiśoḥ kaṇṭhe cakāra kavacaṃ dvijaḥ ..
ātmanaḥ kavacaṃ kaṇṭhe dadhāra ca svayaṃ hariḥ .. 41 ..
4.12.d:
तस्य नन्दशिशोः कण्ठे चकार कवचं द्विजः ॥
आत्मनः कवचं कण्ठे दधार च स्वयं हरिः ॥ 41 ॥
4.12.m:
The brāhmaṇa placed the armour around the neck of that child of Nanda,
and Hari himself bore his own armour around his neck. // 41

4.12.s:
prabhāvaḥ kathitaḥ sarvaḥ kavacasya harestathā ..
anantasyācyutasyaiva prabhāvamatulaṃ mune .. 42 ..
4.12.d:
प्रभावः कथितः सर्वः कवचस्य हरेस्तथा ॥
अनन्तस्याच्युतस्यैव प्रभावमतुलं मुने ॥ 42 ॥
4.12.m:
All the power of the armour has thus been told, O sage,
and the peerless power of Hari, the endless Acyuta. // 42

4.13.s:
.. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca .. ..
aparaṃ kṛṣṇamāhātmyaṃ śṛṇu kiṃcinmahāmune ..
vighnanighnaṃ pāpaharaṃ mahāpuṇyakaraṃ param .. 1 ..
4.13.d:
॥ श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥ ॥
अपरं कृष्णमाहात्म्यं शृणु किंचिन्महामुने ॥
विघ्ननिघ्नं पापहरं महापुण्यकरं परम् ॥ 1 ॥

4.13.s:
ekadā nandapatnī ca kṛtvā kṛṣṇaṃ svavakṣasi ..
svarṇasiṃhāsanasthā ca kṣudhitaṃ taṃ stanaṃ dadau .. 2 ..
4.13.d:
एकदा नन्दपत्नी च कृत्वा कृष्णं स्ववक्षसि ॥
स्वर्णसिंहासनस्था च क्षुधितं तं स्तनं ददौ ॥ 2 ॥

4.13.s:
etasminnantare tatra vipreṃdraikaḥ samāgataḥ ..
vṛtaḥ śiṣyasamūhaiśca prajvalanbrahmatejasā .. 3 ..
4.13.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र विप्रेंद्रैकः समागतः ॥
वृतः शिष्यसमूहैश्च प्रज्वलन्ब्रह्मतेजसा ॥ 3 ॥

4.13.s:
prajapanparamaṃ brahma śuddhasphaṭikamālayā ..
daṇḍī chatrī śuklavāsā dantapaṃktivirājitaḥ .. 4 ..
4.13.d:
प्रजपन्परमं ब्रह्म शुद्धस्फटिकमालया ॥
दण्डी छत्री शुक्लवासा दन्तपंक्तिविराजितः ॥ 4 ॥

4.13.s:
jyotirgraṃtho mūrtimāṃśca vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ ..
paribibhrajjaṭājālaṃ taptakāṃcanasannibham .. 5 ..
4.13.d:
ज्योतिर्ग्रंथो मूर्तिमांश्च वेदवेदांगपारगः ॥
परिबिभ्रज्जटाजालं तप्तकांचनसन्निभम् ॥ 5 ॥

4.13.s:
śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāsyo gaurāṃgaḥ padmalocanaḥ ..
yogīndro dhūrjaṭeḥ śiṣyaḥ śuddhabhakto gadābhṛtaḥ .. 6 ..
4.13.d:
शरत्पार्वणचंद्रास्यो गौरांगः पद्मलोचनः ॥
योगीन्द्रो धूर्जटेः शिष्यः शुद्धभक्तो गदाभृतः ॥ 6 ॥

4.13.s:
vyākhyāmudrākaraḥ śrīmāñchiṣyānadhyāpayanmudā ..
vedavyākhyāṃ katividhāṃ prakurvanniva līlayā .. 7 ..
4.13.d:
व्याख्यामुद्राकरः श्रीमाञ्छिष्यानध्यापयन्मुदा ॥
वेदव्याख्यां कतिविधां प्रकुर्वन्निव लीलया ॥ 7 ॥

4.13.s:
ekībhūya caturvedāstejasā mūrtimāniva..
sākṣātsarasvatīkaṇṭhaḥ siddhāṃtaikaviśāradaḥ .. 8 ..
4.13.d:
एकीभूय चतुर्वेदास्तेजसा मूर्तिमानिव॥
साक्षात्सरस्वतीकण्ठः सिद्धांतैकविशारदः ॥ 8 ॥

4.13.s:
dhyānaikaniṣṭhaḥ śrīkṛṣṇapādāṃbhoje divāniśam ..
jīvanmukto hi siddheśaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvadarśanaḥ .. 9 ..
4.13.d:
ध्यानैकनिष्ठः श्रीकृष्णपादांभोजे दिवानिशम् ॥
जीवन्मुक्तो हि सिद्धेशः सर्वज्ञः सर्वदर्शनः ॥ 9 ॥

4.13.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sā samuttasthau yaśodā praṇanāma ca ..
pādyaṃ gāṃ madhuparkaṃ ca svarṇasiṃhāsanaṃ dadau .. 4.13.10 ..
4.13.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा सा समुत्तस्थौ यशोदा प्रणनाम च ॥
पाद्यं गां मधुपर्कं च स्वर्णसिंहासनं ददौ ॥ 4.13.10 ॥

4.13.s:
bālakaṃ vaṃdayāmāsa munīndraṃ sasmitaṃ mudā ..
muniśca manasā cakre praṇāmaśatakaṃ harim .. 11 ..
4.13.d:
बालकं वंदयामास मुनीन्द्रं सस्मितं मुदा ॥
मुनिश्च मनसा चक्रे प्रणामशतकं हरिम् ॥ 11 ॥

4.13.s:
āśiṣaṃ pradadau prītyā vedamaṃtropayogikam ..
praṇanāma ca śiṣyāṃśca te tāṃ yuyujurāśiṣam ..12..
4.13.d:
आशिषं प्रददौ प्रीत्या वेदमंत्रोपयोगिकम् ॥
प्रणनाम च शिष्यांश्च ते तां युयुजुराशिषम् ॥12॥

4.13.s:
śiṣyānpādyādikaṃ bhaktyā pradadau ca pṛthakpṛthak ..
sāśiṣyāṃghrī ca prakṣālya samuvāsa sukhāsane..13..
4.13.d:
शिष्यान्पाद्यादिकं भक्त्या प्रददौ च पृथक्पृथक् ॥
साशिष्यांघ्री च प्रक्षाल्य समुवास सुखासने॥13॥

4.13.s:
samudyatā sā praṣṭuṃ ca puṭāñjaliyutā satī ..
svakroḍe bālakaṃ kṛtvā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharā .. 14 ..
4.13.d:
समुद्यता सा प्रष्टुं च पुटाञ्जलियुता सती ॥
स्वक्रोडे बालकं कृत्वा भक्तिनम्रात्मकंधरा ॥ 14 ॥

4.13.s:
svātmārāmaṃ maṃgalaṃ ca praṣṭuṃ yadyapi na kṣamā ..
tathā'pi bhavato nāma śivaṃ pṛcchāmi sāṃpratam .. 15 ..
4.13.d:
स्वात्मारामं मंगलं च प्रष्टुं यद्यपि न क्षमा ॥
तथाऽपि भवतो नाम शिवं पृच्छामि सांप्रतम् ॥ 15 ॥

4.13.s:
abalā buddhihīnāyā doṣaṃ kṣaṃtuṃ sadā'rhasi ..
mūḍhasya satataṃ doṣaṃ kṣamāṃ kurvaṃti sādhavaḥ ..16..
4.13.d:
अबला बुद्धिहीनाया दोषं क्षंतुं सदाऽर्हसि ॥
मूढस्य सततं दोषं क्षमां कुर्वंति साधवः ॥16॥

4.13.s:
aṃgirā vā'tha vā'trirvā marīcirgautamo'tha vā ..
kratuḥ kiṃ vā pracetā vā pulastyaḥ pulaho'thavā ..17..
4.13.d:
अंगिरा वाऽथ वाऽत्रिर्वा मरीचिर्गौतमोऽथ वा ॥
क्रतुः किं वा प्रचेता वा पुलस्त्यः पुलहोऽथवा ॥17॥
4.13.m: Or are you Kratu, or Pracetas, or Pulastya, or Pulaha? // 17

4.13.s:
durvāsāḥ kardamastvaṃ vā vaśiṣṭho garga eva vā ..
jaigīṣavyo devalo vā kapilo vā svayaṃ vibhuḥ .. 18 ..
4.13.d:
दुर्वासाः कर्दमस्त्वं वा वशिष्ठो गर्ग एव वा ॥
जैगीषव्यो देवलो वा कपिलो वा स्वयं विभुः ॥ 18 ॥
4.13.m:
Are you Durvāsas, or Kardama, or Vasiṣṭha, or Garga?
Or Jaigīṣavya, or Devala, or the all-pervading Kapila himself? // 18

4.13.s:
sanatkumāraḥ sanakaḥ sanando vā sanātanaḥ ..
voḍhuḥ paṃcaśikho vā tvamāsuriḥ saubhariḥ kimu ..19..
4.13.d:
सनत्कुमारः सनकः सनन्दो वा सनातनः ॥
वोढुः पंचशिखो वा त्वमासुरिः सौभरिः किमु ॥19॥
4.13.m:
Are you Sanatkumāra, Sanaka, Sananda, or Sanātana?
Are you Voḍhu, or Pañcaśikha, or Āsuri, or Saubhari? // 19

4.13.s:
viśvāmitro'tha vālmāko vāmadevo'tha kaśyapaḥ..
saṃvartaḥ kimutathyo vā kiṃ kaco vā bṛhaspatiḥ .. 4.13.20 ..
4.13.d:
विश्वामित्रोऽथ वाल्माको वामदेवोऽथ कश्यपः॥
संवर्तः किमुतथ्यो वा किं कचो वा बृहस्पतिः ॥ 4.13.20 ॥
4.13.m:
Are you Viśvāmitra, or Vālmīki, or Vāmadeva, or Kaśyapa?
Or Samvarta, or Utathya, or Kaca, or Bṛhaspati? // 4.13.20

4.13.s:
bhṛguḥ śukraśca cyavano naranārāyaṇo'thavā ..
sakthinaḥ parāśaro vyāsaḥ śukadevo'tha jaiminiḥ .. 21 ..
4.13.d:
भृगुः शुक्रश्च च्यवनो नरनारायणोऽथवा ॥
सक्थिनः पराशरो व्यासः शुकदेवोऽथ जैमिनिः ॥ 21 ॥
4.13.m:
Are you Bhṛgu, Śukra, Cyavana, or Nara-Nārāyaṇa?
Or Parāśara son of Śakti, Vyāsa, Śukadeva, or Jaimini? // 21

4.13.s:
mārkaṇḍeyo lomaśaśca kaṇvaḥ kātyāyanastathā ..
āstīko vā jaratkārurṛṣyaśṛṃgo vibhāṃḍakaḥ .. 22 ..
4.13.d:
मार्कण्डेयो लोमशश्च कण्वः कात्यायनस्तथा ॥
आस्तीको वा जरत्कारुरृष्यशृंगो विभांडकः ॥ 22 ॥
4.13.m:
Are you Mārkaṇḍeya, Lomaśa, Kaṇva, or Kātyāyana?
Or Āstīka, Jaratkāru, Ṛṣyaśṛṅga, Vibhāṇḍaka? // 22

4.13.s:
paulastyastvamagastyo vā śaradvāngirireva ca ..
śamīko'riṣṭanemiśca māṇḍavyaḥ paila eva ca .. 23 ..
4.13.d:
पौलस्त्यस्त्वमगस्त्यो वा शरद्वान्गिरिरेव च ॥
शमीकोऽरिष्टनेमिश्च माण्डव्यः पैल एव च ॥ 23 ॥
4.13.m:
Are you the son of Pulastya, or Agastya, or Śaradvat, or Giri?
Or Śamīka, Ariṣṭanemi, Māṇḍavya, or Paila? // 23

4.13.s:
pāṇinirvā kaṇādo vā śākalyaḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ ..
aṣṭāvakro bhāgurirvā sumanturvatsa eva vā .. 24 ..
4.13.d:
पाणिनिर्वा कणादो वा शाकल्यः शाकटायनः ॥
अष्टावक्रो भागुरिर्वा सुमन्तुर्वत्स एव वा ॥ 24 ॥
4.13.m:
Or Pāṇini, or Kaṇāda, Śākalya, Śākaṭāyana,
Aṣṭāvakra, or Bhāguri, Sumantu, or Vatsa,

4.13.s:
jābālo yājñavalkyaśca vaiśaṃpāyana eva ca ..
yatirhaṃsī pippalādo maitreyaḥ karuṣastathā .. 25 ..
4.13.d:
जाबालो याज्ञवल्क्यश्च वैशंपायन एव च ॥
यतिर्हंसी पिप्पलादो मैत्रेयः करुषस्तथा ॥ 25 ॥
4.13.m:
Jābāla, Yājñavalkya, and Vaiśaṃpāyana,
the ascetic Haṃsī, Pippalāda, Maitreya, and Karuṣa,

4.13.s:
upamanyurgauramukho'ruṇiraurvo'tha kakṣivān ..
bharadvājo vedaśirā śaṃkukarṇo'tha śaunakaḥ .. 26 ..
4.13.d:
उपमन्युर्गौरमुखोऽरुणिरौर्वोऽथ कक्षिवान् ॥
भरद्वाजो वेदशिरा शंकुकर्णोऽथ शौनकः ॥ 26 ॥
4.13.m:
Upamanyu, Gauramukha, Āruṇi, Aurva, or Kakṣīvant,
Bharadvāja, Vedaśiras, Śaṅkukarṇa, or Śaunaka?

4.13.s:
eteṣāṃ puṇyaślokānāṃ ko bhavānvada me prabho ..
pratyuttarārhā nāhaṃ cettathā'pi vaktumarhasi .. 27 ..
4.13.d:
एतेषां पुण्यश्लोकानां को भवान्वद मे प्रभो ॥
प्रत्युत्तरार्हा नाहं चेत्तथाऽपि वक्तुमर्हसि ॥ 27 ॥
4.13.m:
Among these of holy fame, who are you, my lord? Tell me.
Even if I am not worthy of an answer, still you ought to speak.

4.13.s:
kiṃkaraḥ kiṃkarī vā'pi samarthā prabhumīśvaram ..
yo yasya sevāniyataḥ sa kaṃ pṛcchati taṃ vinā .. 28 ..
4.13.d:
किंकरः किंकरी वाऽपि समर्था प्रभुमीश्वरम् ॥
यो यस्य सेवानियतः स कं पृच्छति तं विना ॥ 28 ॥
4.13.m:
Is a male servant or a female servant capable [of questioning] the lord and master?
He who is devoted to someone's service, whom can he ask besides him?

4.13.s:
dhanyā'haṃ kṛtakṛtyāhaṃ saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ mama ..
tvatpādābjarajaḥsparśājjanmakoṭyaṃhasā kṣayaḥ .. 29 ..
4.13.d:
धन्याऽहं कृतकृत्याहं सफलं जीवितं मम ॥
त्वत्पादाब्जरजःस्पर्शाज्जन्मकोट्यंहसा क्षयः ॥ 29 ॥
4.13.m:
Blessed am I! My purpose is fulfilled, my life has borne fruit!
By touching the dust of your lotus feet, the sins of ten million lifetimes are destroyed.

4.13.s:
tvatpādodakasaṃsparśātsadyaḥ pūtā vasuṃdharā ..
tavāgamanamātreṇa tīrthībhūto mamāśramaḥ 4.13.30 ..
4.13.d:
त्वत्पादोदकसंस्पर्शात्सद्यः पूता वसुंधरा ॥
तवागमनमात्रेण तीर्थीभूतो ममाश्रमः 4.13.30 ॥
4.13.m:
By contact with the water of your feet, the earth is instantly purified.
Merely by your arrival, my hermitage has become a place of pilgrimage. 4.13.30

4.13.s:
yeye śrutāḥ śrutau brahmañcchrutisārā mahājanāḥ ..
teṣāmeko mayā dṛṣṭaḥ pūrvapuṇyaphalodayāt .. 31 ..
4.13.d:
येये श्रुताः श्रुतौ ब्रह्मञ्च्छ्रुतिसारा महाजनाः ॥
तेषामेको मया दृष्टः पूर्वपुण्यफलोदयात् ॥ 31 ॥
4.13.m:
Whichever great souls who are the essence of the Śruti are heard of in the Śruti, O brāhmaṇa,
one of them has been seen by me through the arising of the fruit of past merit.

4.13.s:
śiṣyā vedā mūrtimaṃto grīṣma madhyāhnabhāskarāḥ ..
gokulaṃ matkulaṃ sadyaḥ punaṃti pādareṇunā .. 32 ..
4.13.d:
शिष्या वेदा मूर्तिमंतो ग्रीष्म मध्याह्नभास्कराः ॥
गोकुलं मत्कुलं सद्यः पुनंति पादरेणुना ॥ 32 ॥
4.13.m:
Your disciples are the Vedas incarnate, like midday suns of summer;
they immediately purify Gokula and my lineage with the dust of their feet.

4.13.s:
āśiṣaṃ kartumarhaṃti prasannamanasā śiśum ..
pūrṇasvastyayanaṃ sadyo viprāśīrvacanaṃ dhruvam .. 33 ..
4.13.d:
आशिषं कर्तुमर्हंति प्रसन्नमनसा शिशुम् ॥
पूर्णस्वस्त्ययनं सद्यो विप्राशीर्वचनं ध्रुवम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.13.m:
They ought to bestow blessings upon the child with a gracious mind.
A blessing spoken by a brāhmaṇa is truly a full and immediate invocation of well-being.

4.13.s:
ityevamuktvā naṃdastrī bhaktyā tasthau muneḥ puraḥ ..
naraṃ prasthāpayāmāsa naṃdamānayituṃ satī .. 34 ..
4.13.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा नंदस्त्री भक्त्या तस्थौ मुनेः पुरः ॥
नरं प्रस्थापयामास नंदमानयितुं सती ॥ 34 ॥
4.13.m:
Having spoken thus, Nanda's wife stood before the sage with devotion.
The chaste woman dispatched a man to bring Nanda.

4.13.s:
yaśodāvacanaṃ śrutvā jahāsa munipuṃgavaḥ ..
jahasuḥ śiṣyasaṃghāśca bhāsayaṃto diśo daśa .. 35 ..
4.13.d:
यशोदावचनं श्रुत्वा जहास मुनिपुंगवः ॥
जहसुः शिष्यसंघाश्च भासयंतो दिशो दश ॥ 35 ॥
4.13.m:
Hearing Yaśodā's words, the eminent sage laughed.
And the assembly of disciples laughed, illuminating the ten directions.

4.13.s:
hitaṃ tathyaṃ nītiyuktaṃ mahatpuṇyakaraṃ param ..
tāmuvāca mudā yuktaḥ śuddhabuddhirmahāmuniḥ .. 36 ..
4.13.d:
हितं तथ्यं नीतियुक्तं महत्पुण्यकरं परम् ॥
तामुवाच मुदा युक्तः शुद्धबुद्धिर्महामुनिः ॥ 36 ॥
4.13.m:
Beneficial, true, full of proper conduct, producing great supreme merit,
the great sage of pure intellect, filled with joy, spoke to her:

4.13.s:
śrīgarga uvāca .. ..
sudhāmayaṃ te vacanaṃ laukikaṃ ca kulocitam ..
yasya yatra kule janma sa eva tādṛśo bhavet .. 37 ..
4.13.d:
श्रीगर्ग उवाच ॥ ॥
सुधामयं ते वचनं लौकिकं च कुलोचितम् ॥
यस्य यत्र कुले जन्म स एव तादृशो भवेत् ॥ 37 ॥
4.13.m:
Your speech is filled with nectar, worldly, and suited to your family.
In whichever family one is born, one becomes just like that.

4.13.s:
sarveṣāṃ gopapadmānāṃ giribhānuśca bhāskaraḥ ..
patnī padmāsamā tasya nāmnā padmāvatī satī ..38..
4.13.d:
सर्वेषां गोपपद्मानां गिरिभानुश्च भास्करः ॥
पत्नी पद्मासमा तस्य नाम्ना पद्मावती सती ॥38॥
4.13.m:
Giribhānu is the sun to all the cowherd lotuses.
His chaste wife, equal to Lakṣmī, is named Padmāvatī.

4.13.s:
tasyāḥ kanyā yaśodā tvaṃ yaśovarddhanakāriṇī ..
ballavānāṃ ca pravaro labdho naṃdaśca vallabhaḥ ..39..
4.13.d:
तस्याः कन्या यशोदा त्वं यशोवर्द्धनकारिणी ॥
बल्लवानां च प्रवरो लब्धो नंदश्च वल्लभः ॥39॥
4.13.m:
You, Yaśodā, are her daughter, increasing fame.
And you have obtained as beloved Nanda, the foremost among the cowherds.

4.13.s:
naṃdo yastvaṃ ca yā bhadre bālo yo yena vā gataḥ..
jānāmi nirjane sarvaṃ vakṣyāmi naṃdasannidhim ..4.13.40..
4.13.d:
नंदो यस्त्वं च या भद्रे बालो यो येन वा गतः॥
जानामि निर्जने सर्वं वक्ष्यामि नंदसन्निधिम् ॥4.13.40॥
4.13.m:
Who Nanda is, and who you are, O auspicious lady, and who the child is, and by whom he has come,
I know all of this in private; I shall tell it in the presence of Nanda. 4.13.40

4.13.s:
gargo'haṃ yaduvaṃśānāṃ cirakālaṃ purohitaḥ ..
prasthāpito'haṃ vasunā nānyasādhye ca karmaṇi .. 41 ..
4.13.d:
गर्गोऽहं यदुवंशानां चिरकालं पुरोहितः ॥
प्रस्थापितोऽहं वसुना नान्यसाध्ये च कर्मणि ॥ 41 ॥
4.13.m:
I am Garga, the family priest of the Yadu lineage for a long time.
I was sent by Vasudeva for a task that cannot be accomplished by anyone else.

4.13.s:
etasminnantare naṃdaḥ śrutamātraṃ jagāma ha ..
nanāma daṃḍavadbhūmau mūrdhnā taṃ munipuṃgavam .. 42 ..
4.13.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे नंदः श्रुतमात्रं जगाम ह ॥
ननाम दंडवद्भूमौ मूर्ध्ना तं मुनिपुंगवम् ॥ 42 ॥
4.13.m:
Meanwhile, the moment Nanda heard, he came indeed.
Prostrating like a staff on the earth, he bowed his head to that eminent sage.

4.13.s:
śiṣyānnanāma mūrdhnā ca te taṃ yuyujurāśiṣam..
samutthāyāsanāttūrṇa yaśodānaṃda eva ca ..43..
4.13.d:
शिष्यान्ननाम मूर्ध्ना च ते तं युयुजुराशिषम्॥
समुत्थायासनात्तूर्ण यशोदानंद एव च ॥43॥
4.13.m:
He also bowed his head to the disciples, and they bestowed blessings upon him.
Quickly rising from his seat, Yaśodā and Nanda

4.13.s:
gṛhītvā'bhyaṃtaraṃ ramyaṃ jagāma viduṣāṃ varaḥ ..
gargo naṃdo yaśodā ca saputrā sā mudā'nvitā ..
vākyaṃ gargastadovāca nigūḍhaṃ nirjane mune .. 44 ..
4.13.d:
गृहीत्वाऽभ्यंतरं रम्यं जगाम विदुषां वरः ॥
गर्गो नंदो यशोदा च सपुत्रा सा मुदाऽन्विता ॥
वाक्यं गर्गस्तदोवाच निगूढं निर्जने मुने ॥ 44 ॥
4.13.m:
taking [the sage], the best of the wise went to the charming inner chamber.
Garga, Nanda, and Yaśodā, together with the child, filled with joy—
Garga then spoke a secret word in private, O sage.

4.13.s:
śrīgarga uvāca ..
ayi naṃda pravakṣyāmi vacanaṃ te sukhāvaham ..
prasthāpito'haṃ vasunā yena tacchrūyatāmiti ..45..
4.13.d:
श्रीगर्ग उवाच ॥
अयि नंद प्रवक्ष्यामि वचनं ते सुखावहम् ॥
प्रस्थापितोऽहं वसुना येन तच्छ्रूयतामिति ॥45॥
4.13.m:
O Nanda, I shall tell you words that bring happiness.
Listen to the reason why I was sent by Vasudeva:

4.13.s:
vasunā sūtikāgāre śiśuḥ pratyarpaṇaṃ kṛtaḥ ..
putro'yaṃ vasudevasya jyeṣṭhaśca tasya ca dhruvam .. 46 ..
4.13.d:
वसुना सूतिकागारे शिशुः प्रत्यर्पणं कृतः ॥
पुत्रोऽयं वसुदेवस्य ज्येष्ठश्च तस्य च ध्रुवम् ॥ 46 ॥
4.13.m:
The child was delivered by Vasudeva into the birthing chamber.
This is certainly the son of Vasudeva, and his eldest [born of Devakī].

4.13.s:
kanyā te tena yā nītā mathurāṃ kaṃsabhīruṇā ..
asyānnaprāśanāyāhaṃ nāmānukaraṇāya ca ..
gūḍhena preṣitastena tasyodyogaṃ kuru dvija..47..
4.13.d:
कन्या ते तेन या नीता मथुरां कंसभीरुणा ॥
अस्यान्नप्राशनायाहं नामानुकरणाय च ॥
गूढेन प्रेषितस्तेन तस्योद्योगं कुरु द्विज॥47॥
4.13.m:
Your daughter was taken by him to Mathurā out of fear of Kaṃsa.
For his first feeding of solid food and for the performance of naming him,
I have been sent secretly by him; make preparations for it, O twice-born one.

4.13.s:
pūrṇabrahmasvarūpo'yaṃ śiśuste māyayā mahīm ..
āgatya bhāraharaṇaṃ kartā dhātrā ca sevitaḥ ..
golokanātho bhagavāñchrīkṛṣṇo rādhikāpatiḥ .. 48 ..
4.13.d:
पूर्णब्रह्मस्वरूपोऽयं शिशुस्ते मायया महीम् ॥
आगत्य भारहरणं कर्ता धात्रा च सेवितः ॥
गोलोकनाथो भगवाञ्छ्रीकृष्णो राधिकापतिः ॥ 48 ॥
4.13.m:
This child of yours, the very form of the full Brahman, has come to earth by his illusory potency
to remove the earth's burden, and he is served by the Creator [Brahmā].
He is the Lord of Goloka, the Blessed Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the husband of Rādhikā.

4.13.s:
nārāyaṇo yo vaikuṃṭhe kamalākāṃta eva ca ..
śvetadvīpanivāsī yaḥ pitā viṣṇuśca so'pyajaḥ .. 49 ..
4.13.d:
नारायणो यो वैकुंठे कमलाकांत एव च ॥
श्वेतद्वीपनिवासी यः पिता विष्णुश्च सोऽप्यजः ॥ 49 ॥
4.13.m:
He who is Nārāyaṇa in Vaikuṇṭha, the beloved of Lakṣmī,
and Viṣṇu, the unborn father who dwells in Śvetadvīpa,

4.13.s:
kapilo'nye tadaṃśāśca naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī ..
sarveṣāṃ tejasāṃ rāśirmūrtimānāgataḥ kimu .. 4.13.50 ..
4.13.d:
कपिलोऽन्ये तदंशाश्च नरनारायणावृषी ॥
सर्वेषां तेजसां राशिर्मूर्तिमानागतः किमु ॥ 4.13.50 ॥
4.13.m:
Kapila, and the sages Nara and Nārāyaṇa are his portions.
Indeed, is he not the mass of all splendours that has come embodied?

4.13.s:
taṃ vasuṃ darśayitvā ca śiśurūpo babhūva ha ..
sāṃprataṃ sūtikāgārādājagāma tavālayam .. 51 ..
4.13.d:
तं वसुं दर्शयित्वा च शिशुरूपो बभूव ह ॥
सांप्रतं सूतिकागारादाजगाम तवालयम् ॥ 51 ॥
4.13.m:
And having shown that [divine form] to Vasudeva, he became of the form of a child.
He has now arrived at your home from the lying-in chamber.

4.13.s:
ayonisaṃbhavaścāyamāvirbhūto mahītale ..
vāyupūrṇaṃ mātṛgarbhe kṛtvā ca māyayā hariḥ .. 52 ..
4.13.d:
अयोनिसंभवश्चायमाविर्भूतो महीतले ॥
वायुपूर्णं मातृगर्भे कृत्वा च मायया हरिः ॥ 52 ॥
4.13.m:
Not born from a womb, he has manifested himself upon the surface of the earth.
Filling the mother's womb with wind by his illusory power, Hari,

4.13.s:
āvirbhūya vasuṃ mūrtiṃ darśayitvā jagāma ha ..
yugeyuge varṇabhedo nāmabhedo'sya ballava ..53 ..
4.13.d:
आविर्भूय वसुं मूर्तिं दर्शयित्वा जगाम ह ॥
युगेयुगे वर्णभेदो नामभेदोऽस्य बल्लव ॥53 ॥
4.13.m:
having manifested and having shown his divine form, indeed departed.
In age after age, his color changes, and his names change, O cowherd!

4.13.s:
śuklaḥ pītastathā rakta idānīṃ kṛṣṇatāṃ gataḥ ..
śuklavarṇaḥ satyayuge sutīvratejasā vṛtaḥ .. 54 ..
4.13.d:
शुक्लः पीतस्तथा रक्त इदानीं कृष्णतां गतः ॥
शुक्लवर्णः सत्ययुगे सुतीव्रतेजसा वृतः ॥ 54 ॥
4.13.m:
White, yellow, and red, he has now become black (Kṛṣṇa).
In the Satya Yuga he is white in color, enveloped by very intense splendor;

4.13.s:
tretāyāṃ raktavarṇo'yaṃ pīto'yaṃ dvāpare vibhuḥ ..
kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ kalau śrīmāṃstejasāṃ rāśireva ca ..55..
4.13.d:
त्रेतायां रक्तवर्णोऽयं पीतोऽयं द्वापरे विभुः ॥
कृष्णवर्णः कलौ श्रीमांस्तेजसां राशिरेव च ॥55॥
4.13.m:
in the Tretā Yuga he is red in color; in the Dvāpara Yuga this all-pervading lord is yellow;
in the Kali Yuga the glorious one is black in color, a veritable mass of splendor.

4.13.s:
paripūrṇatamaṃ brahma tena kṛṣṇa iti smṛtaḥ ..
brahmaṇo vācakaḥ ko'yamṛkāro'naṃtavācakaḥ .. 56 ..
4.13.d:
परिपूर्णतमं ब्रह्म तेन कृष्ण इति स्मृतः ॥
ब्रह्मणो वाचकः कोऽयमृकारोऽनंतवाचकः ॥ 56 ॥
4.13.m:
He is the most complete Brahman; therefore he is remembered as Kṛṣṇa.
The letter 'k' expresses Brahman; the letter 'ṛ' expresses the Infinite;

4.13.s:
śivasya vācakaḥ ṣaśca nakāro dharmavācakaḥ ..
akāro viṣṇuvacanaḥ śvetadvīpanivāsinaḥ .. 57 ..
4.13.d:
शिवस्य वाचकः षश्च नकारो धर्मवाचकः ॥
अकारो विष्णुवचनः श्वेतद्वीपनिवासिनः ॥ 57 ॥
4.13.m:
the letter 'ṣ' expresses Śiva; and the letter 'n' expresses Dharma;
the letter 'a' denotes Viṣṇu, who dwells in Śvetadvīpa;

4.13.s:
naranārāyaṇārthasya visargo vācakaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
sarveṣāṃ tejasāṃ rāśiḥ sarvamūrtisvarūpakaḥ .. 58 ..
4.13.d:
नरनारायणार्थस्य विसर्गो वाचकः स्मृतः ॥
सर्वेषां तेजसां राशिः सर्वमूर्तिस्वरूपकः ॥ 58 ॥
4.13.m:
and the visarga is remembered as expressing the meaning of Nara and Nārāyaṇa.
He is the mass of all splendor, the embodied nature of all forms,

4.13.s:
sarvādhāraḥ sarvabījastena kṛṣṇa iti smṛtaḥ ..
karmanirmūlavacanaḥ kṛṣirno dāsyavācakaḥ .. 59 ..
4.13.d:
सर्वाधारः सर्वबीजस्तेन कृष्ण इति स्मृतः ॥
कर्मनिर्मूलवचनः कृषिर्नो दास्यवाचकः ॥ 59 ॥
4.13.m:
the support of all, the seed of all; therefore he is remembered as Kṛṣṇa.
The verbal root 'kṛṣ' signifies the uprooting of karma, and 'n' denotes servitude;

4.13.s:
akāro dātṛvacanastena kṛṣṇa iti smṛtaḥ ..
kṛṣirniśceṣṭavacano nakāro bhaktivācakaḥ .. 4.13.60 ..
4.13.d:
अकारो दातृवचनस्तेन कृष्ण इति स्मृतः ॥
कृषिर्निश्चेष्टवचनो नकारो भक्तिवाचकः ॥ 4.13.60 ॥
4.13.m: The verbal root 'kṛṣ' signifies cessation of action, and the letter 'n' denotes devotion;

4.13.s:
akāraḥ prāptivacanastena kṛṣṇa iti smṛtaḥ ..
kṛṣirnirvāṇavacano nakāro mokṣavācakaḥ .. .. 61 ..
4.13.d:
अकारः प्राप्तिवचनस्तेन कृष्ण इति स्मृतः ॥
कृषिर्निर्वाणवचनो नकारो मोक्षवाचकः ॥ ॥ 61 ॥
4.13.m:
the letter 'a' denotes attainment; therefore he is remembered as Kṛṣṇa.
The verbal root 'kṛṣ' signifies nirvāṇa, and the letter 'n' denotes liberation;

4.13.s:
akāro dātṛvacanastena kṛṣṇa iti smṛtaḥ ..
nāmnāṃ bhagavato naṃda koṭīnāṃ smaraṇena yat .. 62 ..
4.13.d:
अकारो दातृवचनस्तेन कृष्ण इति स्मृतः ॥
नाम्नां भगवतो नंद कोटीनां स्मरणेन यत् ॥ 62 ॥
4.13.m: Whatever fruit is attained by remembering ten million names of the Blessed Lord, O Nanda,

4.13.s:
tatphalaṃ labhate nūnaṃ kṛṣṇeti smaraṇe naraḥ ..
yadvidhaṃ smaraṇātpuṇyaṃ vacanācchravaṇāttathā .. 63 ..
4.13.d:
तत्फलं लभते नूनं कृष्णेति स्मरणे नरः ॥
यद्विधं स्मरणात्पुण्यं वचनाच्छ्रवणात्तथा ॥ 63 ॥
4.13.m:
surely a man attains that very fruit merely by remembering the name 'Kṛṣṇa'.
Such merit as comes from remembering, so too from speaking and hearing,

4.13.s:
koṭijanmāṃhaso nāśo bhavedyatsmaraṇādikāt ..
viṣṇornāmnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sārātsāraṃ parātparam .. 64 ..
4.13.d:
कोटिजन्मांहसो नाशो भवेद्यत्स्मरणादिकात् ॥
विष्णोर्नाम्नां च सर्वेषां सारात्सारं परात्परम् ॥ 64 ॥
4.13.m:
by remembering which the sins of ten million lifetimes are destroyed.
Of all the names of Viṣṇu, the most essential of the essential, higher than the highest,

4.13.s:
kṛṣṇeti suṃdaraṃ nāma maṃgalaṃ bhaktidāyakam ..
kakāroccāraṇādbhaktaḥ kaivalyaṃ mṛtyujanmaham .. 69..
4.13.d:
कृष्णेति सुंदरं नाम मंगलं भक्तिदायकम् ॥
ककारोच्चारणाद्भक्तः कैवल्यं मृत्युजन्महम् ॥ 69॥
4.13.m:
is the beautiful name 'Kṛṣṇa', which is auspicious and bestows devotion.
From uttering the letter 'k', a devotee attains absolute freedom, which destroys death and rebirth;

4.13.s:
ṛkārāddāsyamatulaṃ ṣakārādbhaktimīpsitām ..
nakārātsahavāsaṃ ca tatsamaṃ kālameva ca .. 66 ..
4.13.d:
ऋकाराद्दास्यमतुलं षकाराद्भक्तिमीप्सिताम् ॥
नकारात्सहवासं च तत्समं कालमेव च ॥ 66 ॥
4.13.m:
from the letter 'ṛ', incomparable servitude; from the letter 'ṣ', desired devotion;
from the letter 'n', co-residence [with him] for a duration equal to his own;

4.13.s:
tatsārūpyaṃ visargācca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
kakāroccāraṇādeva vepaṃte yamakiṃkarāḥ ..67..
4.13.d:
तत्सारूप्यं विसर्गाच्च लभते नात्र संशयः ॥
ककारोच्चारणादेव वेपंते यमकिंकराः ॥67॥
4.13.m:
and from the visarga, he attains likeness of form with him; of this there is no doubt.
At the very utterance of the letter 'k', the servants of Yama tremble;

4.13.s:
ṛkārokterna tiṣṭhaṃti ṣakārātpātakāni ca ..
nakāroccāraṇādrogā akārānmṛtyureva ca .. 68 ..
4.13.d:
ऋकारोक्तेर्न तिष्ठंति षकारात्पातकानि च ॥
नकारोच्चारणाद्रोगा अकारान्मृत्युरेव च ॥ 68 ॥
4.13.m:
at the pronunciation of the letter 'ṛ', sins do not remain, nor at the letter 'ṣ';
at the utterance of the letter 'n', diseases flee, and at the letter 'a', death itself;

4.13.s:
dhruvaṃ sarve palāyaṃte nāmoccāraṇabhīravaḥ ..
smṛtyuktiśravaṇodyogātkṛṣṇanāmno vrajeśvara .. 69 ..
4.13.d:
ध्रुवं सर्वे पलायंते नामोच्चारणभीरवः ॥
स्मृत्युक्तिश्रवणोद्योगात्कृष्णनाम्नो व्रजेश्वर ॥ 69 ॥
4.13.m:
surely they all flee, terrified by the utterance of the name.
From the intent to remember, speak, or hear the name of Kṛṣṇa, O lord of Vraja,

4.13.s:
rathaṃ gṛhītvā dhāvaṃti golokātkṛṣṇakiṃkarāḥ ..
pṛthivyā rajasaḥ saṃkhyāṃ kartuṃ śaktā vipaścitaḥ .. 4.13.70 ..
4.13.d:
रथं गृहीत्वा धावंति गोलोकात्कृष्णकिंकराः ॥
पृथिव्या रजसः संख्यां कर्तुं शक्ता विपश्चितः ॥ 4.13.70 ॥
4.13.m:
the servants of Kṛṣṇa come rushing with a chariot from Goloka.
Wise men are capable of counting the dust-particles of the earth;

4.13.s:
nāmnaḥ prabhāvasaṃkhyānaṃ saṃto vaktuṃ na ca kṣamāḥ ..
purā śaṃkaravaktreṇa nāmno'sya mahimā śrutaḥ ..71 ..
4.13.d:
नाम्नः प्रभावसंख्यानं संतो वक्तुं न च क्षमाः ॥
पुरा शंकरवक्त्रेण नाम्नोऽस्य महिमा श्रुतः ॥71 ॥
4.13.m:
the virtuous are unable to state the count of the name's power.
In ancient times, the greatness of this name was heard from the mouth of Śaṅkara;

4.13.s:
guṇānnāmaprabhāvaṃ ca kiṃcijjānāti madguruḥ ..
brahmā'naṃtaśca dharmaśca surarṣimanumānavāḥ .. 72 ..
4.13.d:
गुणान्नामप्रभावं च किंचिज्जानाति मद्गुरुः ॥
ब्रह्माऽनंतश्च धर्मश्च सुरर्षिमनुमानवाः ॥ 72 ॥
4.13.m:
my guru knows a little of his qualities and the power of his name.
Brahmā, Ananta, Dharma, divine sages, Manus, and men,

4.13.s:
vedāḥ saṃto na jānaṃti mahimnaḥ ṣoḍaśīṃ kalām ..
ityevaṃ kathito naṃda mahimā ca sutasya ca ..73..
4.13.d:
वेदाः संतो न जानंति महिम्नः षोडशीं कलाम् ॥
इत्येवं कथितो नंद महिमा च सुतस्य च ॥73॥
4.13.m:
the Vedas, and the virtuous do not know even a sixteenth part of his greatness.
Thus has the greatness of your son been spoken, O Nanda,

4.13.s:
yathāmati yathājñānaṃ guruvaktrādyathā śrutam ..
kṛṣṇaḥ pītāṃbaraḥ kaṃsadhvaṃsī ca viṣṭaraśravāḥ .. 74 ..
4.13.d:
यथामति यथाज्ञानं गुरुवक्त्राद्यथा श्रुतम् ॥
कृष्णः पीतांबरः कंसध्वंसी च विष्टरश्रवाः ॥ 74 ॥
4.13.m:
according to my understanding, according to my knowledge, and as heard from the mouth of my guru.
[He is] Kṛṣṇa, clad in yellow garments, slayer of Kaṃsa, Viṣṭaraśravas,

4.13.s:
devakīnaṃdanaḥ śrīśo yaśodānaṃdano hariḥ ..
sanātano'cyuto'naṃtaḥ sarveśaḥ sarvarūpadhṛk .. 75 ..
4.13.d:
देवकीनंदनः श्रीशो यशोदानंदनो हरिः ॥
सनातनोऽच्युतोऽनंतः सर्वेशः सर्वरूपधृक् ॥ 75 ॥
4.13.m:
son of Devakī, lord of Śrī, son of Yaśodā, Hari,
eternal, Acyuta, Ananta, lord of all, assuming all forms,

4.13.s:
sarvādhāraḥ sarvagatiḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ..
rādhābaṃdhū rādhikātmā rādhikājīvanaṃ svayam .. 76 ..
4.13.d:
सर्वाधारः सर्वगतिः सर्वकारणकारणम् ॥
राधाबंधू राधिकात्मा राधिकाजीवनं स्वयम् ॥ 76 ॥
4.13.m:
support of all, goal of all, cause of all causes,
kinsman of Rādhā, soul of Rādhikā, the very life of Rādhikā,

4.13.s:
rādhāprāṇo rādhikeśo rādhikāramaṇaḥ svayam ..
rādhikāsahacārī ca rādhāmānasapūraṇaḥ .. 77 ...
4.13.d:
राधाप्राणो राधिकेशो राधिकारमणः स्वयम् ॥
राधिकासहचारी च राधामानसपूरणः ॥ 77 ॥।
4.13.m:
the vital breath of Rādhā, lord of Rādhikā, lover of Rādhikā himself,
companion of Rādhikā, fulfiller of Rādhā's desires,

4.13.s:
rādhādhano rādhikāṃgo rādhikāsaktamānasaḥ ..
rādhikācittacoraśca rādhāprāṇādhikaḥ prabhuḥ .. 78 ..
4.13.d:
राधाधनो राधिकांगो राधिकासक्तमानसः ॥
राधिकाचित्तचोरश्च राधाप्राणाधिकः प्रभुः ॥ 78 ॥
4.13.m:
wealth of Rādhā, Rādhikā's own body, his mind attached to Rādhikā,
thief of Rādhikā's heart, dearer than life to Rādhā, the Lord,

4.13.s:
paripūrṇatamaṃ brahma goviṃdo garuḍadhvajaḥ ..
nāmānyetāni kṛṣṇasya śrutāni manmukhāddhṛdi .. 79 ..
4.13.d:
परिपूर्णतमं ब्रह्म गोविंदो गरुडध्वजः ॥
नामान्येतानि कृष्णस्य श्रुतानि मन्मुखाद्धृदि ॥ 79 ॥
4.13.m:
the most complete Brahman, Govinda, who has Garuḍa on his banner.
These names of Kṛṣṇa, heard from my mouth, keep in your heart,

4.13.s:
janmamṛtyuharāṇyeva rakṣa naṃda śubhekṣaṇa ..
kṛtaṃ nirūpaṇaṃ nāmnāṃ kaniṣṭhasya yathā śrutam .. 4.13.80 ..
4.13.d:
जन्ममृत्युहराण्येव रक्ष नंद शुभेक्षण ॥
कृतं निरूपणं नाम्नां कनिष्ठस्य यथा श्रुतम् ॥ 4.13.80 ॥
4.13.m:
for they indeed remove birth and death, O fair-eyed Nanda!
The determination of the names of the younger child has been made as it was heard;

4.13.s:
jyeṣṭhasya halino nāmnaḥ saṃketaṃ śṛṇu manmukhāt ..
garbhasaṃkarṣaṇādeva nāmnā saṃkarṣaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 81 ..
4.13.d:
ज्येष्ठस्य हलिनो नाम्नः संकेतं शृणु मन्मुखात् ॥
गर्भसंकर्षणादेव नाम्ना संकर्षणः स्मृतः ॥ 81 ॥
4.13.m:
hear now from my mouth the explanation of the name of the elder, the plow-holder.
From the extraction of the womb (garbhasaṃkarṣaṇa), he is remembered by the name Saṃkarṣaṇa.

4.13.s:
nāstyaṃto'syaiva vedeṣu tenānaṃta iti smṛtaḥ ..
baladevo balodrekāddhalī ca haladhāraṇāt..82 ..
4.13.d:
नास्त्यंतोऽस्यैव वेदेषु तेनानंत इति स्मृतः ॥
बलदेवो बलोद्रेकाद्धली च हलधारणात्॥82 ॥
4.13.m:
There is indeed no end (anta) to him in the Vedas; therefore he is remembered as Ananta.
He is Baladeva from the excess of strength (bala), and Halin from holding a plough (hala);

4.13.s:
śitivāsā nīlavāsānmusalī musalāyudhāt ..
revatyā saha saṃbhogādrevatīramaṇaḥ svayam ..83..
4.13.d:
शितिवासा नीलवासान्मुसली मुसलायुधात् ॥
रेवत्या सह संभोगाद्रेवतीरमणः स्वयम् ॥83॥
4.13.m:
Śitivāsas and Nīlavāsas [from his dark-blue garments], and Musalin from his club-weapon (musala);
From enjoying with Revatī, he is himself Revatīramaṇa;

4.13.s:
rohiṇīgarbhavāsāttu rauhiṇeyo mahāmatiḥ ..
ityevaṃ jyeṣṭhaputrasya śrutaṃ nāma niveditam ..84..
4.13.d:
रोहिणीगर्भवासात्तु रौहिणेयो महामतिः ॥
इत्येवं ज्येष्ठपुत्रस्य श्रुतं नाम निवेदितम् ॥84॥
4.13.m:
And from dwelling in the womb of Rohiṇī, the wise one is Rauhiṇeya.
Thus the name of your eldest son has been heard and declared.

4.13.s:
yāsyāmyahaṃ gṛhaṃ naṃda sukhaṃ tiṣṭha svamaṃdire ..
brāhmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā naṃdaḥ stabdho babhūva ha .. 85 ..
4.13.d:
यास्याम्यहं गृहं नंद सुखं तिष्ठ स्वमंदिरे ॥
ब्राह्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा नंदः स्तब्धो बभूव ह ॥ 85 ॥
4.13.m:
I shall go home, O Nanda; remain happily in your own house.”
Hearing the brahmin's words, Nanda indeed became motionless;

4.13.s:
niśceṣṭā naṃdapatnī ca jahāsa bālakaḥ svayam ..
praṇamyovāca naṃdastaṃ vākyaṃ vinayapūrvakam .. 86 ..
4.13.d:
निश्चेष्टा नंदपत्नी च जहास बालकः स्वयम् ॥
प्रणम्योवाच नंदस्तं वाक्यं विनयपूर्वकम् ॥ 86 ॥
4.13.m:
Nanda's wife was inactive, and the boy himself laughed.
Bowing, Nanda spoke modest words to him,

4.13.s:
puṭāṃjaliyuto bhūtvā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharaḥ ..
naṃda uvāca ..
gataścettvaṃ tadā karma kariṣyatyeva ko mahān ..87..
4.13.d:
पुटांजलियुतो भूत्वा भक्तिनम्रात्मकंधरः ॥
नंद उवाच ॥
गतश्चेत्त्वं तदा कर्म करिष्यत्येव को महान् ॥87॥
4.13.m:
having joined his hands with palms together, with neck bent low in devotion.
“If you go, then which great person will perform the rite?

4.13.s:
svayaṃ śubhekṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā kuru nāmnā'nnaprāśanam ..
yannāmaughaśca kathito rādhāprāṇādiko daśa .. .. 88 ..
4.13.d:
स्वयं शुभेक्षणं कृत्वा कुरु नाम्नाऽन्नप्राशनम् ॥
यन्नामौघश्च कथितो राधाप्राणादिको दश ॥ ॥ 88 ॥
4.13.m:
Having yourself chosen an auspicious moment, perform the first feeding of solid food along with [the giving of] the name.
As for that multitude of ten names that was recited, beginning with 'Rādhā's life-breath',

4.13.s:
tasyāpi kā vā rādheti kanyakā kasya ca dhruvam..
naṃdasya vacanaṃ śrutvā jahāsa munipuṃgavaḥ..
nigūḍhaṃ paramaṃ tattvaṃ rahasyaṃ kathayāmi te .. 89 ..
4.13.d:
तस्यापि का वा राधेति कन्यका कस्य च ध्रुवम्॥
नंदस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा जहास मुनिपुंगवः॥
निगूढं परमं तत्त्वं रहस्यं कथयामि ते ॥ 89 ॥
4.13.m:
who indeed is that Rādhā, and whose daughter is she surely?”
Hearing Nanda’s words, the best of sages laughed:
“I will tell you the deeply hidden, supreme reality, a secret.

4.13.s:
.. śrīgarga uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu naṃda pravakṣyāmi itihāsaṃ purātanam .. 4.13.90 ..
4.13.d:
॥ श्रीगर्ग उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणु नंद प्रवक्ष्यामि इतिहासं पुरातनम् ॥ 4.13.90 ॥
4.13.m: Listen, O Nanda, I shall tell an ancient history.

4.13.s:
purā golokavṛttāṃtaṃ śrutaṃ śaṃkaravaktrataḥ..
śrīdāmno rādhayā sārddhaṃ babhūva kalaho mahān .. 91 ..
4.13.d:
पुरा गोलोकवृत्तांतं श्रुतं शंकरवक्त्रतः॥
श्रीदाम्नो राधया सार्द्धं बभूव कलहो महान् ॥ 91 ॥
4.13.m:
Long ago, an account of Goloka was heard from the mouth of Śaṅkara:
A great quarrel took place between Śrīdāman and Rādhā.

4.13.s:
śrīdāmaśāpāddaivena gopī rādhā ca gokule ..
vṛṣabhānusutā sā ca mātā tasyāḥ kalāvatī .. 92 ..
4.13.d:
श्रीदामशापाद्दैवेन गोपी राधा च गोकुले ॥
वृषभानुसुता सा च माता तस्याः कलावती ॥ 92 ॥
4.13.m:
By Śrīdāman’s curse and by destiny, the cowherd woman Rādhā [was born] in Gokula;
she is the daughter of Vṛṣabhānu, and her mother is Kalāvatī.

4.13.s:
kṛṣṇasyārddhāṃgasaṃbhūtā nāthasya sadṛśī satī ..
golokavāsinī seyamatra kṛṣṇājñayā'dhunā .. 93 ..
4.13.d:
कृष्णस्यार्द्धांगसंभूता नाथस्य सदृशी सती ॥
गोलोकवासिनी सेयमत्र कृष्णाज्ञयाऽधुना ॥ 93 ॥
4.13.m:
Born from half the body of Kṛṣṇa, equal to her Lord, the virtuous woman,
this dweller of Goloka is now here by Kṛṣṇa’s command.

4.13.s:
ayonisaṃbhavā devī mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ..
māturgarbhaṃ vāyupūrṇaṃ kṛtvā ca māyayā satī .. 94 ..
4.13.d:
अयोनिसंभवा देवी मूलप्रकृतिरीश्वरी ॥
मातुर्गर्भं वायुपूर्णं कृत्वा च मायया सती ॥ 94 ॥
4.13.m:
The goddess not born from a womb, the sovereign Primeval Prakṛti (Mūlaprakṛti),
having filled her mother’s womb with wind by her illusory power (māyā), the virtuous one,

4.13.s:
vāyuniḥsaraṇe kāle dhṛtvā ca śiśuvigraham ..
āvirbabhūva māyeyaṃ pṛthvyāṃ kṛṣṇopadeśataḥ .. 95 ..
4.13.d:
वायुनिःसरणे काले धृत्वा च शिशुविग्रहम् ॥
आविर्बभूव मायेयं पृथ्व्यां कृष्णोपदेशतः ॥ 95 ॥
4.13.m:
at the time of the expulsion of the wind, assuming the form of an infant,
this māyā appeared on earth by the instruction of Kṛṣṇa.

4.13.s:
vardhate sā vraje rādhā śukle caṃdrakalā yathā ..
śrīkṛṣṇatejaso'rddhena sā ca mṛrtimatī satī .. 96 ..
4.13.d:
वर्धते सा व्रजे राधा शुक्ले चंद्रकला यथा ॥
श्रीकृष्णतेजसोऽर्द्धेन सा च मृर्तिमती सती ॥ 96 ॥
4.13.m:
She, Rādhā, grows in Vraja like the digit of the moon in the bright fortnight.
And that virtuous woman is the embodiment of half of Śrī Kṛṣṇa’s splendor;

4.13.s:
ekā mūrtirdvidhābhūtā bhedo vede nirūpitaḥ ..
iyaṃ strī sā pumān kiṃvā sā vā kāṃtā pumānayam ..97..
4.13.d:
एका मूर्तिर्द्विधाभूता भेदो वेदे निरूपितः ॥
इयं स्त्री सा पुमान् किंवा सा वा कांता पुमानयम् ॥97॥
4.13.m:
one form has become two; the distinction is described in the Veda:
Is this one the female and that one the male, or is that one the beloved woman and this one the male?

4.13.s:
dve rūpe tejasā tulye rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca ..
parākrameṇa buddhyā vā jñānena saṃpadā'pi ca .. 98 ..
4.13.d:
द्वे रूपे तेजसा तुल्ये रूपेण च गुणेन च ॥
पराक्रमेण बुद्ध्या वा ज्ञानेन संपदाऽपि च ॥ 98 ॥
4.13.m:
The two forms are equal in splendor, in beauty, and in virtue;
in valor, or in intellect, in knowledge, and also in wealth.

4.13.s:
purato gamanenaiva kiṃtu sāvayasādhikā ..
dhyāyate tāmayaṃ śaśvadimaṃ sā smarati priyam .. 99 ..
4.13.d:
पुरतो गमनेनैव किंतु सावयसाधिका ॥
ध्यायते तामयं शश्वदिमं सा स्मरति प्रियम् ॥ 99 ॥
4.13.m:
Yet solely by going ahead, she is superior in age.
This one constantly meditates on her; she remembers this beloved one.

4.13.s:
racitā sā'sya prāṇaiśca tatprāṇairmūrtimānayam ..
asya rādhānusāreṇa gokulāgamanaṃ param .. 4.13.100 ..
4.13.d:
रचिता साऽस्य प्राणैश्च तत्प्राणैर्मूर्तिमानयम् ॥
अस्य राधानुसारेण गोकुलागमनं परम् ॥ 4.13.100 ॥
4.13.m:
She was formed by his vital breaths, and this embodied one [was formed] by her vital breaths.
His coming to Gokula was strictly in pursuit of Rādhā,

4.13.s:
svīkāraṃ sārthakaṃ kartuṃ gokule yatkṛtaṃ purā ..
kaṃsabhīticchalenaiva gokulāgamanaṃ hareḥ..101..
4.13.d:
स्वीकारं सार्थकं कर्तुं गोकुले यत्कृतं पुरा ॥
कंसभीतिच्छलेनैव गोकुलागमनं हरेः॥101॥
4.13.m:
to fulfill the promise that was made in Gokula long ago.
Hari’s coming to Gokula was merely under the pretext of fear of Kaṃsa;

4.13.s:
pratijñāpālanārthāya bhayeśasya bhayaṃ kutaḥ ..
rādhāśabdasya vyutpattiḥ sāmavede nirūpitā.. 102 ..
4.13.d:
प्रतिज्ञापालनार्थाय भयेशस्य भयं कुतः ॥
राधाशब्दस्य व्युत्पत्तिः सामवेदे निरूपिता॥ 102 ॥
4.13.m:
whence could fear arise for the master of fear, [except] for the sake of keeping a promise?
The etymology of the word ‘Rādhā’ is expounded in the Sāmaveda.

4.13.s:
nārāyaṇastāmuvāca brahmāṇaṃ nābhipaṃkaje ..
brahmā tāṃ kathayāmāsa brahmaloke ca śaṃkaram .. 103 ..
4.13.d:
नारायणस्तामुवाच ब्रह्माणं नाभिपंकजे ॥
ब्रह्मा तां कथयामास ब्रह्मलोके च शंकरम् ॥ 103 ॥
4.13.m:
Nārāyaṇa spoke it to Brahmā in the navel-lotus;
Brahmā told it in Brahmaloka to Śaṅkara;

4.13.s:
purā kailāsaśikhare māmuvāca maheśvaraḥ ..
devānāṃ durlabhāṃ naṃda niśāmaya vadāmi te .. 104 ..
4.13.d:
पुरा कैलासशिखरे मामुवाच महेश्वरः ॥
देवानां दुर्लभां नंद निशामय वदामि ते ॥ 104 ॥
4.13.m:
long ago on the peak of Kailāsa, Maheśvara told it to me.
Hear it, O Nanda, difficult even for the gods to obtain; I tell it to you,

4.13.s:
surāsuramunīṃdrāṇāṃ vāṃchitāṃ muktidāṃ parām ..
repho hi koṭijanmāghaṃ karmabhogaṃ śubhāśubham ..105..
4.13.d:
सुरासुरमुनींद्राणां वांछितां मुक्तिदां पराम् ॥
रेफो हि कोटिजन्माघं कर्मभोगं शुभाशुभम् ॥105॥
4.13.m:
desired by gods, asuras, and great sages, bestowing supreme liberation.
The letter 'r' [dispels] the sin of ten million births, the experiencing of karma, auspicious and inauspicious;

4.13.s:
ākāro garbhavāsaṃ ca mṛtyuṃ ca rogamutsṛjet ..
dhakāra āyuṣo hānimākāro bhavabaṃdhanam .. 106 ..
4.13.d:
आकारो गर्भवासं च मृत्युं च रोगमुत्सृजेत् ॥
धकार आयुषो हानिमाकारो भवबंधनम् ॥ 106 ॥
4.13.m:
the long vowel 'ā' removes dwelling in a womb, death, and disease;
the letter 'dh' [dispels] loss of lifespan, and the long vowel 'ā' [dispels] the bond of worldly existence;

4.13.s:
śravaṇasmaraṇoktibhyaḥ praṇaśyati na saṃśayaḥ ..
repho hi niścalāṃ bhaktiṃ dāsyaṃ kṛṣṇapadāṃbuje .. 107 ..
4.13.d:
श्रवणस्मरणोक्तिभ्यः प्रणश्यति न संशयः ॥
रेफो हि निश्चलां भक्तिं दास्यं कृष्णपदांबुजे ॥ 107 ॥
4.13.m:
by hearing, remembering, and uttering them, they are destroyed—there is no doubt.
The letter 'r' [grants] unswerving devotion and servitude at Kṛṣṇa’s lotus-feet,

4.13.s:
sarvepsitaṃ sadānaṃdaṃ sarvasiddhaughamīśvaram ..
dhakāraḥ sahavāsaṃ ca tattulyakālameva ca .. 108 ..
4.13.d:
सर्वेप्सितं सदानंदं सर्वसिद्धौघमीश्वरम् ॥
धकारः सहवासं च तत्तुल्यकालमेव च ॥ 108 ॥
4.13.m:
all desires, eternal bliss, the multitude of all perfections, and the Lord;
the letter 'dh' [grants] co-residence with him and for the same duration of time,

4.13.s:
dadāti sārṣṭisārūpyaṃ tattvajñānaṃ hareḥ samam..
ākārastejasāṃ rāśiṃ dānaśaktiṃ harau yathā ..109..
4.13.d:
ददाति सार्ष्टिसारूप्यं तत्त्वज्ञानं हरेः समम्॥
आकारस्तेजसां राशिं दानशक्तिं हरौ यथा ॥109॥
4.13.m:
it gives equal power (sārṣṭi), equal form (sārūpya), and knowledge of reality equal to Hari's;
the long vowel 'ā' [gives] a mass of splendor, the power of giving as in Hari,

4.13.s:
yogaśaktiṃ yogamatiṃ sarvakālaṃ harismṛtim ..
śrutyuktismaraṇādyogānmohajālaṃ ca kilbiṣam .. 4.13.110 ..
4.13.d:
योगशक्तिं योगमतिं सर्वकालं हरिस्मृतिम् ॥
श्रुत्युक्तिस्मरणाद्योगान्मोहजालं च किल्बिषम् ॥ 4.13.110 ॥
4.13.m:
the power of yoga, a mind bent on yoga, and constant remembrance of Hari.
From the yoga consisting of remembrance of what the scriptures say, the snare of delusion and sin,

4.13.s:
rogaśokamṛtyuyamā vepaṃte nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
rādhāmādhavayoḥ kiṃcidvyākhyānaṃ ca yataḥ śrutam .. 111 ..
4.13.d:
रोगशोकमृत्युयमा वेपंते नात्र संशयः ॥
राधामाधवयोः किंचिद्व्याख्यानं च यतः श्रुतम् ॥ 111 ॥
4.13.m:
Disease, sorrow, death, and Yama tremble—of this there is no doubt.
And in whatever manner a little explanation of Rādhā and Mādhava was heard [by me],

4.13.s:
taduktaṃ ca yathājñānaṃ sākalyaṃ vaktumakṣamaḥ..
ārād vṛṃdāvane naṃda vivāho bhavitā'nayoḥ .. 112 ..
4.13.d:
तदुक्तं च यथाज्ञानं साकल्यं वक्तुमक्षमः॥
आराद् वृंदावने नंद विवाहो भविताऽनयोः ॥ 112 ॥
4.13.m:
That has been spoken according to my knowledge; I am unable to tell it in its entirety.
Nearby, in Vṛndāvana, O Nanda, the marriage of these two will take place.

4.13.s:
purohito jagaddhātā kṛtvā'gniṃ sākṣiṇaṃ mudā ..
kuberaputramokṣaṃ ca gavyasyāhṛtya bhakṣaṇam .. .. 113 ..
4.13.d:
पुरोहितो जगद्धाता कृत्वाऽग्निं साक्षिणं मुदा ॥
कुबेरपुत्रमोक्षं च गव्यस्याहृत्य भक्षणम् ॥ ॥ 113 ॥
4.13.m:
The Creator of the universe [will be] the family priest, joyfully making fire the witness.
And the liberation of the sons of Kubera, the gathering and eating of milk-products,

4.13.s:
hiṃsanaṃ dhenukasyaiva kānane tālabhojanam ..
bakakeśipralaṃbānāṃ hiṃsanaṃ cātha līlayā .. 114 ..
4.13.d:
हिंसनं धेनुकस्यैव कानने तालभोजनम् ॥
बककेशिप्रलंबानां हिंसनं चाथ लीलया ॥ 114 ॥
4.13.m:
The slaying of Dhenuka, the eating of palm fruit in the forest,
And then the playful slaying of Baka, Keśin, and Pralamba,

4.13.s:
mokṣaṇaṃ dvijapatnīnāṃ miṣṭānnapānabhojanam ..
bhaṃjanaṃ śakrayāgasya śakrādgokularakṣaṇam .. 115..
4.13.d:
मोक्षणं द्विजपत्नीनां मिष्टान्नपानभोजनम् ॥
भंजनं शक्रयागस्य शक्राद्गोकुलरक्षणम् ॥ 115॥
4.13.m:
The liberation of the wives of the brahmins, the eating of sweet foods and drink,
The breaking of the sacrifice to Śakra, the protection of Gokula from Śakra,

4.13.s:
gopīnāṃ vastraharaṇaṃ vratasaṃpādanaṃ tathā ..
tābhyaḥ punarvastradānaṃ varadānaṃ yathepsitam .. 116 ..
4.13.d:
गोपीनां वस्त्रहरणं व्रतसंपादनं तथा ॥
ताभ्यः पुनर्वस्त्रदानं वरदानं यथेप्सितम् ॥ 116 ॥
4.13.m:
The stealing of the clothes of the cowherd women and the fulfillment of their vow,
The return of the clothes to them, the granting of boons as desired,

4.13.s:
cetasāṃ haraṇaṃ tāsāmayaṃ vaśyāḥ kariṣyati ..
rāsotsavaṃ mahāramyaṃ sarveṣāṃ harṣavarddhanam .. 117 ..
4.13.d:
चेतसां हरणं तासामयं वश्याः करिष्यति ॥
रासोत्सवं महारम्यं सर्वेषां हर्षवर्द्धनम् ॥ 117 ॥
4.13.m:
The stealing of their hearts; he will make them subservient [to him].
The exceedingly charming rāsa festival, increasing the joy of all,

4.13.s:
pūrṇacandrodaye naktaṃ vasaṃte rāsamaṃḍale ..
gopīnāṃ navasaṃbhogātkṛtvā pūrṇaṃ manoratham .. 118 ..
4.13.d:
पूर्णचन्द्रोदये नक्तं वसंते रासमंडले ॥
गोपीनां नवसंभोगात्कृत्वा पूर्णं मनोरथम् ॥ 118 ॥
4.13.m:
At the rising of the full moon, at night, in the spring, in the circle of the rāsa dance,
Fulfilling the desires of the cowherd women through fresh enjoyment,

4.13.s:
tābhiḥ saha jalakrīḍāṃ kariṣyati kutūhalāt ..
vicchedo'sya varṣaśataṃ śrīdāmaśāpahetukam .. 119 ..
4.13.d:
ताभिः सह जलक्रीडां करिष्यति कुतूहलात् ॥
विच्छेदोऽस्य वर्षशतं श्रीदामशापहेतुकम् ॥ 119 ॥
4.13.m:
He will sport playfully in the water together with them.
A separation of one hundred years for him, caused by the curse of Śrīdāman,

4.13.s:
gopālairgopikābhiśca bhavitā rādhayā saha ..
mathurāgamanaṃ tatra gopīnāṃ śokavarddhanam ..4.13.120..
4.13.d:
गोपालैर्गोपिकाभिश्च भविता राधया सह ॥
मथुरागमनं तत्र गोपीनां शोकवर्द्धनम् ॥4.13.120॥
4.13.m:
Will occur, from the cowherds, the cowherd women, and from Rādhā.
The departure to Mathurā, causing grief to increase for the cowherd women there,

4.13.s:
punaḥ prabodhanaṃ tāsāṃ dānamādhyātmikasya ca ..
syaṃdanākrūrayo rakṣāṃ sadyastābhyāṃ kariṣyati ..121..
4.13.d:
पुनः प्रबोधनं तासां दानमाध्यात्मिकस्य च ॥
स्यंदनाक्रूरयो रक्षां सद्यस्ताभ्यां करिष्यति ॥121॥
4.13.m:
His comforting them again, and the imparting of spiritual knowledge,
He will instantly bring about the protection of the chariot and of Akrūra through both of them.

4.13.s:
rathamārohaṇaṃ kṛtvā mathurāgamanaṃ punaḥ ..
pitṛbhrātṛvrajaiḥ sārddhaṃ vilaṃghya yamunāṃ vraje .. 122 ..
4.13.d:
रथमारोहणं कृत्वा मथुरागमनं पुनः ॥
पितृभ्रातृव्रजैः सार्द्धं विलंघ्य यमुनां व्रजे ॥ 122 ॥
4.13.m:
Mounting the chariot, the going to Mathurā again,
Crossing the Yamunā in Vraja together with the throng of elders and brothers,

4.13.s:
akrūrāya jñānadānaṃ darśayitvā svakaṃ jale ..
kautukena ca sāyāhne nagarātsarvadarśanam .. 123 ..
4.13.d:
अक्रूराय ज्ञानदानं दर्शयित्वा स्वकं जले ॥
कौतुकेन च सायाह्ने नगरात्सर्वदर्शनम् ॥ 123 ॥
4.13.m:
Bestowing knowledge upon Akrūra, revealing his own form in the water,
And playfully in the evening, sightseeing throughout the city,

4.13.s:
mālākārataṃtuvāyakubjānāṃ baṃdhamokṣaṇam ..
dhanurbhaṃgaṃ śaṃkarasya yāgasthāna pradarśanam .. 124 ..
4.13.d:
मालाकारतंतुवायकुब्जानां बंधमोक्षणम् ॥
धनुर्भंगं शंकरस्य यागस्थान प्रदर्शनम् ॥ 124 ॥
4.13.m:
The liberation from bondage of the garland-maker, the weaver, and Kubjā,
The breaking of Śaṅkara's bow, the viewing of the sacrificial arena,

4.13.s:
hiṃsanaṃ gajamallānāṃ darśanaṃ nṛpateḥ puraḥ..
kaṃsasya hiṃsanaṃ sadyaḥ pitrornigaḍamokṣaṇam .. 125 ..
4.13.d:
हिंसनं गजमल्लानां दर्शनं नृपतेः पुरः॥
कंसस्य हिंसनं सद्यः पित्रोर्निगडमोक्षणम् ॥ 125 ॥
4.13.m:
The killing of the elephant and the wrestlers, appearing before the king,
The killing of Kaṃsa forthwith, the releasing of his parents from their fetters,

4.13.s:
prabodhanaṃ ca yuṣmākamugrasenābhiṣecanam ..
tasyatasya vadhūnāṃ ca jñānācchokāpanodanam .. 126 ..
4.13.d:
प्रबोधनं च युष्माकमुग्रसेनाभिषेचनम् ॥
तस्यतस्य वधूनां च ज्ञानाच्छोकापनोदनम् ॥ 126 ॥
4.13.m:
And the consoling of you all, the consecration of Ugrasena,
And dispelling the grief of his women through knowledge,

4.13.s:
bhrātuḥ svasyopanayanaṃ vidyādānaṃ gurormukhāt ..
guruputrapradānaṃ ca punarāgamanaṃ gṛhe .. 127 ..
4.13.d:
भ्रातुः स्वस्योपनयनं विद्यादानं गुरोर्मुखात् ॥
गुरुपुत्रप्रदानं च पुनरागमनं गृहे ॥ 127 ॥
4.13.m:
The sacred thread ceremony of his brother and himself, the receiving of learning from the guru's mouth,
The restoration of the guru's son, and returning home again,

4.13.s:
chalanaṃ nṛpasainyānāṃ yavanasya durātmanaḥ ..
nirmāṇaṃ dvārakāyāśca mucukuṃdasya mokṣaṇam .. .. 128 ..
4.13.d:
छलनं नृपसैन्यानां यवनस्य दुरात्मनः ॥
निर्माणं द्वारकायाश्च मुचुकुंदस्य मोक्षणम् ॥ ॥ 128 ॥
4.13.m:
The outwitting of the royal armies and of the evil-minded Yavana,
The building of Dvārakā, and the liberation of Mucukunda,

4.13.s:
dvārakāgamanaṃ caiva yādavaiḥ saha kautukāt ..
strīsaṃghānāṃ viharaṇaṃ tābhiḥ sārddhaṃ ca krīḍanam .. 129 ..
4.13.d:
द्वारकागमनं चैव यादवैः सह कौतुकात् ॥
स्त्रीसंघानां विहरणं ताभिः सार्द्धं च क्रीडनम् ॥ 129 ॥
4.13.m:
The departure to Dvārakā playfully along with the Yādavas,
Sporting with the groups of women and dallying with them,

4.13.s:
saubhāgyavardhanaṃ tāsāṃ putrapautrādikasya ca ..
maṇisaṃbaṃdhino mithyākalaṃkasya ca mokṣaṇam .. 4.13.130 ..
4.13.d:
सौभाग्यवर्धनं तासां पुत्रपौत्रादिकस्य च ॥
मणिसंबंधिनो मिथ्याकलंकस्य च मोक्षणम् ॥ 4.13.130 ॥
4.13.m:
Increasing their good fortune, and [the birth of] sons, grandsons, and so forth,
And the dispelling of the false blemish concerning the jewel,

4.13.s:
sāhāyyaṃ pāṃḍavānāṃ ca bhārāvataraṇādikam ..
niṣpannaṃ rājasūyasya dharmaputrasya līlayā ..131..
4.13.d:
साहाय्यं पांडवानां च भारावतरणादिकम् ॥
निष्पन्नं राजसूयस्य धर्मपुत्रस्य लीलया ॥131॥
4.13.m:
Assistance to the Pāṇḍavas, the lifting of the burden [of the earth] and so forth,
The completion of the Rājasūya of the son of Dharma playfully,

4.13.s:
pārijātasya haraṇaṃ śakrāhaṃkāramardanam ..
vratapūrṇaṃ ca satyāyā bāṇasya bhujakṛntanam .. 132 ..
4.13.d:
पारिजातस्य हरणं शक्राहंकारमर्दनम् ॥
व्रतपूर्णं च सत्याया बाणस्य भुजकृन्तनम् ॥ 132 ॥
4.13.m:
The taking of the Pārijāta flower, the crushing of Śakra's pride,
The fulfillment of Satyā's vow, the severing of Bāṇa's arms,

4.13.s:
mardanaṃ śivasainyānāṃ harasya jṛṃbhaṇaṃ param..
haraṇaṃ bāṇaputryāścaivāniruddhasya mokṣaṇam .. 133 ..
4.13.d:
मर्दनं शिवसैन्यानां हरस्य जृंभणं परम्॥
हरणं बाणपुत्र्याश्चैवानिरुद्धस्य मोक्षणम् ॥ 133 ॥
4.13.m:
The crushing of Śiva's armies, the great yawning of Hara,
The abduction of Bāṇa's daughter, and the liberation of Aniruddha,

4.13.s:
vārāṇasyāśca dahanaṃ vipradāridryabhaṃjanam ..
vipraputrapradānaṃ ca duṣṭānāṃ damanādikam .. 134 ..
4.13.d:
वाराणस्याश्च दहनं विप्रदारिद्र्यभंजनम् ॥
विप्रपुत्रप्रदानं च दुष्टानां दमनादिकम् ॥ 134 ॥
4.13.m:
The burning of Vārāṇasī, the ending of the brahmin's poverty,
The restoration of the brahmin's sons, the subduing of the wicked and so on,

4.13.s:
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena yuṣmābhiḥ saha darśanam ..
kṛtvā ca rādhayā sārdhaṃ vrajamāgamitā punaḥ .. 135 ..
4.13.d:
तीर्थयात्राप्रसंगेन युष्माभिः सह दर्शनम् ॥
कृत्वा च राधया सार्धं व्रजमागमिता पुनः ॥ 135 ॥
4.13.m:
Meeting with you all on the occasion of a pilgrimage to holy sites,
And having returned to Vraja together with Rādhā,

4.13.s:
prasthāpayitvā dvārāṃ ca paraṃ nārāyaṇāṃśakam ..
sarvaṃ niṣpādanaṃ kṛtvā golokaṃ rādhayā saha .. 136..
4.13.d:
प्रस्थापयित्वा द्वारां च परं नारायणांशकम् ॥
सर्वं निष्पादनं कृत्वा गोलोकं राधया सह ॥ 136॥
4.13.m:
Having dispatched to Dvārakā the supreme portion that is Nārāyaṇa,
Having accomplished everything, to Goloka together with Rādhā,

4.13.s:
gamiṣyatyeva golokaṃ nātho'yaṃ jagatāṃ patiḥ..
nārāyaṇaśca vaikuṃṭhaṃ gamitā sma tvayā saha .. 137 ..
4.13.d:
गमिष्यत्येव गोलोकं नाथोऽयं जगतां पतिः॥
नारायणश्च वैकुंठं गमिता स्म त्वया सह ॥ 137 ॥
4.13.m:
This Lord, Master of the worlds, will indeed go to Goloka.
And Nārāyaṇa will go to Vaikuṇṭha together with you.

4.13.s:
dharmagehamṛṣī dvau ca viṣṇuḥ kṣīrodameva ca ..
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ naṃda bhaviṣyaṃ vedanirṇayam .. 138 ..
4.13.d:
धर्मगेहमृषी द्वौ च विष्णुः क्षीरोदमेव च ॥
इत्येवं कथितं नंद भविष्यं वेदनिर्णयम् ॥ 138 ॥
4.13.m:
The two ṛṣis to the abode of Dharma, and Viṣṇu to the Milk Ocean.
Thus, O Nanda, the future has been spoken as determined by the Vedas.

4.13.s:
śrūyatāṃ sāṃprataṃ karma yadarthaṃ gamanaṃ mama ..
māghaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ kuru karma śubhe kṣaṇe .. 139 ..
4.13.d:
श्रूयतां सांप्रतं कर्म यदर्थं गमनं मम ॥
माघशुक्लचतुर्दश्यां कुरु कर्म शुभे क्षणे ॥ 139 ॥
4.13.m:
Hear now the ritual for the sake of which is my arrival:
On the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight of Māgha, perform the rite at an auspicious moment,

4.13.s:
guruvāre ca revatyāṃ viśuddhe caṃdratārake ..
caṃdrasthe mīnalagne ca lagneśapūrṇadarśane .. 4.13.140 ..
4.13.d:
गुरुवारे च रेवत्यां विशुद्धे चंद्रतारके ॥
चंद्रस्थे मीनलग्ने च लग्नेशपूर्णदर्शने ॥ 4.13.140 ॥
4.13.m:
On a Thursday, in the Revatī asterism, when the moon and the stars are pure.
when the moon is present in the ascendant of Pisces and with the full aspect of the lord of the ascendant,

4.13.s:
vaṇije karaṇotkṛṣṭe śubhayoge manohare ..
sudurlabhe dine tatra sarvotkṛṣṭopayogike .. 141 ..
4.13.d:
वणिजे करणोत्कृष्टे शुभयोगे मनोहरे ॥
