मयेत्युक्तो हरिरयमुवाच मां तपस्विनम् ॥ 98 ॥
4.15.m:
O one beyond the gunas, show them to me quickly, right now.'
Addressed thus by me, this Hari said to me, an ascetic:

4.15.s:
darśayiṣyāmi kāle ca vatsedānīṃ kṣameti ca ..
nahīśvarājñā viphalā tena dṛṣṭaṃ padāmbujam .. 99 ..
4.15.d:
दर्शयिष्यामि काले च वत्सेदानीं क्षमेति च ॥
नहीश्वराज्ञा विफला तेन दृष्टं पदाम्बुजम् ॥ 99 ॥
4.15.m:
'I will show them in time, my child; for now, be patient.'
The command of the Lord is never in vain; therefore your lotus foot has now been seen,

4.15.s:
sarveṣāṃ vāñchitaṃ mātargoloke bhārate'dhunā ..
sarvā devyaḥ prakṛtyaṃśā janyāḥ prākṛtikā dhruvam .. 4.15.100 ..
4.15.d:
सर्वेषां वाञ्छितं मातर्गोलोके भारतेऽधुना ॥
सर्वा देव्यः प्रकृत्यंशा जन्याः प्राकृतिका ध्रुवम् ॥ 4.15.100 ॥
4.15.m:
which is desired by everyone in Goloka, and now in Bhārata, O Mother.
All goddesses are portions of Prakṛti, certainly born and material;

4.15.s:
tvaṃ kṛṣṇāṅgārdhasaṃbhūtā tulyā kṛṣṇena sarvataḥ ..
śrīkṛṣṇastvamayaṃ rādhā tvaṃ rādhā vā hariḥ svayam .. 101 ..
4.15.d:
त्वं कृष्णाङ्गार्धसंभूता तुल्या कृष्णेन सर्वतः ॥
श्रीकृष्णस्त्वमयं राधा त्वं राधा वा हरिः स्वयम् ॥ 101 ॥
4.15.m:
but you have arisen from half of Kṛṣṇa's body, equal to Kṛṣṇa in every way.
[Are] you Śrī Kṛṣṇa, and is he Rādhā? Or are you Rādhā, [and he] Hari himself?

4.15.s:
nahi vedeṣu me dṛṣṭa iti kena nirūpitam ..
brahmāṇḍādbahirūrdhvaṃ ca goloko'sti yathāmbike .. 102 ..
4.15.d:
नहि वेदेषु मे दृष्ट इति केन निरूपितम् ॥
ब्रह्माण्डाद्बहिरूर्ध्वं च गोलोकोऽस्ति यथाम्बिके ॥ 102 ॥
4.15.m:
Indeed, I have not seen this in the Vedas; by whom has it been determined?
Just as Goloka exists outside and above the cosmic egg, O Mother,

4.15.s:
vaikuṇṭhaścāpyajanyaśca tvamajanyā tathāmbike ..
yathā samastabrahmāṇḍe śrīkṛṣṇāṃśāṃśajīvinaḥ..103..
4.15.d:
वैकुण्ठश्चाप्यजन्यश्च त्वमजन्या तथाम्बिके ॥
यथा समस्तब्रह्माण्डे श्रीकृष्णांशांशजीविनः॥103॥
4.15.m:
and Vaikuṇṭha is uncreated, so too are you uncreated, O Mother.
Just as in the entire cosmic egg living beings are portions of the portion of Śrī Kṛṣṇa,

4.15.s:
tathā śaktisvarūpā tvaṃ teṣu sarveṣu saṃsthitā..
puruṣāśca hareraṃśāstvadaṃśā nikhilāḥ striyaḥ ..104..
4.15.d:
तथा शक्तिस्वरूपा त्वं तेषु सर्वेषु संस्थिता॥
पुरुषाश्च हरेरंशास्त्वदंशा निखिलाः स्त्रियः ॥104॥
4.15.m:
so do you, whose essence is power, reside within them all.
Men are portions of Hari, and all women are portions of you.

4.15.s:
ātmanā deharūpā tvamasyādhārastvameva hi..
asyānu prāṇaistvaṃ mātastvatprāṇairayamīśvaraḥ ..105..
4.15.d:
आत्मना देहरूपा त्वमस्याधारस्त्वमेव हि॥
अस्यानु प्राणैस्त्वं मातस्त्वत्प्राणैरयमीश्वरः ॥105॥
4.15.m:
With the Ātman, you have the nature of the body; you alone are indeed his foundation.
Following his life-breaths are you, O Mother; and by your life-breaths is this Lord [alive].

4.15.s:
kimaho nirmitaḥ kena hetunā śilpakāriṇā ..
nityo'yaṃ ca tathā kṛṣṇastvaṃ ca nityā tathā'mbike .. 106 ..
4.15.d:
किमहो निर्मितः केन हेतुना शिल्पकारिणा ॥
नित्योऽयं च तथा कृष्णस्त्वं च नित्या तथाऽम्बिके ॥ 106 ॥
4.15.m:
Ah, how, [and] for what purpose was this created by the master artisan?
He is eternal, this Kṛṣṇa, and you are also eternal, O Mother.

4.15.s:
asyāṃśā tvaṃ tvadaṃśo vā'pyayaṃ kena nirūpitaḥ ..
ahaṃ vidhātā jagatāṃ devānāṃ janakaḥ svayam .. 107 ..
4.15.d:
अस्यांशा त्वं त्वदंशो वाऽप्ययं केन निरूपितः ॥
अहं विधाता जगतां देवानां जनकः स्वयम् ॥ 107 ॥
4.15.m:
Are you a portion of him, or is he a portion of you? By whom has this been determined?
I am the creator of the worlds, the father of the gods myself;

4.15.s:
taṃ paṭhitvā gurumukhādbhavantyeva budhā janāḥ ..
guṇānāṃ vāstavānāṃ te śatāṃśaṃ vaktumakṣamaḥ .. 108 ..
4.15.d:
तं पठित्वा गुरुमुखाद्भवन्त्येव बुधा जनाः ॥
गुणानां वास्तवानां ते शतांशं वक्तुमक्षमः ॥ 108 ॥
4.15.m:
having studied that [Veda] from the mouth of the guru, wise men become learned.
Yet I am unable to declare a hundredth part of your real virtues.

4.15.s:
vedo vā paṇḍito vā'nyaḥ ko vā tvāṃ stotumīśvaraḥ ..
stavānāṃ janakaṃ jñānaṃ buddhirjñānāmbikā sadā .. 109 ..
4.15.d:
वेदो वा पण्डितो वाऽन्यः को वा त्वां स्तोतुमीश्वरः ॥
स्तवानां जनकं ज्ञानं बुद्धिर्ज्ञानाम्बिका सदा ॥ 109 ॥
4.15.m:
Whether the Veda, or a learned scholar, or someone else—who is able to praise you?
Knowledge is the father of praises, and intellect is ever the mother of knowledge;

4.15.s:
tvaṃ buddherjananī mātaḥ ko vā tvāṃ stotumīśvaraḥ ..
yadvastu dṛṣṭaṃ sarveṣāṃ taddhi vaktuṃ budhaḥ kṣamaḥ ..4.15.110..
4.15.d:
त्वं बुद्धेर्जननी मातः को वा त्वां स्तोतुमीश्वरः ॥
यद्वस्तु दृष्टं सर्वेषां तद्धि वक्तुं बुधः क्षमः ॥4.15.110॥
4.15.m:
you are the mother of the intellect, O Mother—who is able to praise you?
Whatever matter is seen by all, that indeed a wise man is able to describe;

4.15.s:
yadadṛṣṭāśrute vastu tannirvaktuṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ ..
ahaṃ maheśo'naṃtaśca stotuṃ tvāṃ ko'pi na kṣamaḥ.. 111 ..
4.15.d:
यददृष्टाश्रुते वस्तु तन्निर्वक्तुं च कः क्षमः ॥
अहं महेशोऽनंतश्च स्तोतुं त्वां कोऽपि न क्षमः॥ 111 ॥
4.15.m:
but when a thing is unseen and unheard, who is capable of describing it?
I, Maheśa, and Ananta—none of us is able to praise you;

4.15.s:
sarasvatī ca vedāśca kṣamaḥ kaḥ stotumīśvaraḥ ..
yathāgamaṃ yathoktaṃ ca na māṃ ninditumarhasi .. 112 ..
4.15.d:
सरस्वती च वेदाश्च क्षमः कः स्तोतुमीश्वरः ॥
यथागमं यथोक्तं च न मां निन्दितुमर्हसि ॥ 112 ॥
4.15.m:
Sarasvatī and the Vedas—who is able to praise [you], the Supreme Lady?
According to the sacred texts and as I have spoken, you ought not to fault me.

4.15.s:
īśvarāṇāmīśvarasya yogyāyogye samā kṛpā..
janasya pratipālyasya kṣaṇe doṣaḥ kṣaṇe guṇaḥ .. 113 ..
4.15.d:
ईश्वराणामीश्वरस्य योग्यायोग्ये समा कृपा॥
जनस्य प्रतिपाल्यस्य क्षणे दोषः क्षणे गुणः ॥ 113 ॥
4.15.m:
The mercy of the Lord of lords is equal toward the worthy and the unworthy.
A servant being maintained has faults at one moment, virtues at another moment;

4.15.s:
jananī janako yo vā sarvaṃ kṣamati snehataḥ ..
ityuktvā jagatāṃ dhātā tasthau ca puratastayoḥ ..114..
4.15.d:
जननी जनको यो वा सर्वं क्षमति स्नेहतः ॥
इत्युक्त्वा जगतां धाता तस्थौ च पुरतस्तयोः ॥114॥
4.15.m:
a mother or a father forgives everything out of affection."
Having spoken thus, the creator of the worlds stood before the two of them,

4.15.s:
praṇamya caraṇāmbhoje sarveṣāṃ vandyamīpsitam ..
brahmaṇā ca kṛtaṃ stotraṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ ..115..
4.15.d:
प्रणम्य चरणाम्भोजे सर्वेषां वन्द्यमीप्सितम् ॥
ब्रह्मणा च कृतं स्तोत्रं त्रिसंध्यं यः पठेन्नरः ॥115॥
4.15.m:
having bowed down to the lotus-feet desired and worthy of worship by all.
Whatever man recites at the three twilights this hymn of praise composed by Brahmā

4.15.s:
rādhāmādhavayoḥ pāde bhaktirdāsyaṃ labheddhruvam ..
karmanirmūlanaṃ kṛtvā mṛtyuṃ jitvā sudurjayam ..
vilaṅghya sarvalokāṃśca yāti golokamuttamam.. 116..
4.15.d:
राधामाधवयोः पादे भक्तिर्दास्यं लभेद्ध्रुवम् ॥
कर्मनिर्मूलनं कृत्वा मृत्युं जित्वा सुदुर्जयम् ॥
विलङ्घ्य सर्वलोकांश्च याति गोलोकमुत्तमम्॥ 116॥
4.15.m:
surely attains devotion and servitude at the feet of Rādhā and Mādhava.
Having uprooted all karma, having conquered very unconquerable death,
and having transcended all realms, he goes to supreme Goloka.

4.15.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca..
brahmaṇaḥ stavanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca ha rādhikā .. 117 ..
4.15.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच॥
ब्रह्मणः स्तवनं श्रुत्वा तमुवाच ह राधिका ॥ 117 ॥
4.15.m: Having heard the praise of Brahmā, Rādhikā indeed spoke to him:

4.15.s:
varaṃ vṛṇu vidhātastvaṃ yatte manasi vartate ..
rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā tāmuvāca jagadvidhiḥ .. 118 ..
4.15.d:
वरं वृणु विधातस्त्वं यत्ते मनसि वर्तते ॥
राधिकावचनं श्रुत्वा तामुवाच जगद्विधिः ॥ 118 ॥
4.15.m:
"Choose a boon, O creator, whatever is in your mind."
Hearing the words of Rādhikā, the creator of the world said to her:

4.15.s:
varaṃ ca yuvayoḥ pādapadmabhaktiṃ ca dehi me ..
ityukte vidhinā rādhā tūrṇamomityuvāca ha .. 119 ..
4.15.d:
वरं च युवयोः पादपद्मभक्तिं च देहि मे ॥
इत्युक्ते विधिना राधा तूर्णमोमित्युवाच ह ॥ 119 ॥
4.15.m:
"Grant me as a boon devotion to the lotus feet of you both."
When this was spoken by the creator, Rādhā quickly said, "Om."

4.15.s:
punarnanāma tāṃ bhaktyā vidhātā jagatāṃ patiḥ ..
tadā brahmā tayormadhye prajvālya ca hutāśanam .. 4.15.120 ..
4.15.d:
पुनर्ननाम तां भक्त्या विधाता जगतां पतिः ॥
तदा ब्रह्मा तयोर्मध्ये प्रज्वाल्य च हुताशनम् ॥ 4.15.120 ॥
4.15.m:
Again the creator, the lord of the worlds, bowed down to her with devotion.
Then Brahmā, having kindled a sacrificial fire between the two of them,

4.15.s:
hariṃ saṃsmṛtya havanaṃ cakāra vidhinā vidhiḥ..
utthāya śayanātkṛṣṇa uvāsa vahnisannidhau .. 121 ..
4.15.d:
हरिं संस्मृत्य हवनं चकार विधिना विधिः॥
उत्थाय शयनात्कृष्ण उवास वह्निसन्निधौ ॥ 121 ॥
4.15.m:
meditated on Hari, and the creator performed the oblation according to the ritual.
Arising from his couch, Kṛṣṇa sat near the fire;

4.15.s:
brahmaṇoktena vidhinā cakāra havanaṃ svayam ..
praṇamayya punaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ rādhāṃ tāṃ janakaḥ svayam .. 122 ..
4.15.d:
ब्रह्मणोक्तेन विधिना चकार हवनं स्वयम् ॥
प्रणमय्य पुनः कृष्णं राधां तां जनकः स्वयम् ॥ 122 ॥
4.15.m:
by the rule spoken by Brahmā, he himself performed the oblation.
The Creator himself, having made Kṛṣṇa and Rādhā bow down again,

4.15.s:
kautukaṃ kārayāmāsa saptadhā ca pradakṣiṇām ..
punaḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ rādhāṃ kārayitvā hutāśanam .. 123 ..
4.15.d:
कौतुकं कारयामास सप्तधा च प्रदक्षिणाम् ॥
पुनः प्रदक्षिणां राधां कारयित्वा हुताशनम् ॥ 123 ॥
4.15.m:
delightfully had them circumambulate [the fire] seven times.
Having made Rādhā again circumambulate the sacrificial fire,

4.15.s:
praṇamayya tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vāsayāmāsa taṃ vidhiḥ ..
tasyā hastaṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ grāhayāmāsa taṃ vidhiḥ .. 124..
4.15.d:
प्रणमय्य ततः कृष्णं वासयामास तं विधिः ॥
तस्या हस्तं च श्रीकृष्णं ग्राहयामास तं विधिः ॥ 124॥
4.15.m:
and having made Kṛṣṇa bow down, the creator then seated him.
The creator made Śrī Kṛṣṇa take her hand,

4.15.s:
vedoktasaptamantrāṃśca pāṭhayāmāsa mādhavam ..
saṃsthāpya rādhikāhastaṃ harervakṣasi vedavit .. 125 ..
4.15.d:
वेदोक्तसप्तमन्त्रांश्च पाठयामास माधवम् ॥
संस्थाप्य राधिकाहस्तं हरेर्वक्षसि वेदवित् ॥ 125 ॥
4.15.m:
and made Mādhava recite the seven mantras declared in the Vedas.
Placing Rādhikā's hand upon Hari's chest, the knower of the Veda,

4.15.s:
śrīkṛṣṇahastaṃ rādhāyāḥ pṛṣṭhadeśe prajāpatiḥ ..
sthāpayāmāsa mantrāṃstrīnpāṭhayāmāsa rādhikām ..126..
4.15.d:
श्रीकृष्णहस्तं राधायाः पृष्ठदेशे प्रजापतिः ॥
स्थापयामास मन्त्रांस्त्रीन्पाठयामास राधिकाम् ॥126॥
4.15.m:
Prajāpati, placed Śrī Kṛṣṇa's hand upon the back of Rādhā,
and caused Rādhikā to recite three mantras.

4.15.s:
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālāṃ jānuvilambitām ..
śrīkṛṣṇasya gale brahmā rādhādvārā dadau mudā .. 127 ..
4.15.d:
पारिजातप्रसूनानां मालां जानुविलम्बिताम् ॥
श्रीकृष्णस्य गले ब्रह्मा राधाद्वारा ददौ मुदा ॥ 127 ॥
4.15.m:
Brahmā gladly caused Rādhā to place a garland of pārijāta blossoms
hanging down to the knees around the neck of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

4.15.s:
praṇamayya punaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ rādhāṃ ca kamalodbhavaḥ ..
rādhāgale haridvārā dadau mālāṃ manoharām..
punaśca vāsayāmāsa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ kamalodbhavaḥ .. 128 ..
4.15.d:
प्रणमय्य पुनः कृष्णं राधां च कमलोद्भवः ॥
राधागले हरिद्वारा ददौ मालां मनोहराम्॥
पुनश्च वासयामास श्रीकृष्णं कमलोद्भवः ॥ 128 ॥
4.15.m:
Having again made Kṛṣṇa and Rādhā bow down, the Lotus-born
placed the captivating garland around Rādhā's neck through Hari.
And the Lotus-born seated Śrī Kṛṣṇa again,

4.15.s:
tadvāmapārśve rādhāṃ ca sasmitāṃ kṛṣṇacetasam ..
puṭāñjaliṃ kārayitvā mādhavaṃ rādhikāṃ vidhiḥ .. ..129..
4.15.d:
तद्वामपार्श्वे राधां च सस्मितां कृष्णचेतसम् ॥
पुटाञ्जलिं कारयित्वा माधवं राधिकां विधिः ॥ ॥129॥
4.15.m:
and at his left side Rādhā, smiling, whose mind was set on Kṛṣṇa.
Having made Mādhava and Rādhikā join their palms, the creator

4.15.s:
pāṭhayāmāsa vedoktānpañca mantrāṃśca nārada ..
praṇamayya punaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ samarpya rādhikāṃ vidhiḥ .. 4.15.130 ..
4.15.d:
पाठयामास वेदोक्तान्पञ्च मन्त्रांश्च नारद ॥
प्रणमय्य पुनः कृष्णं समर्प्य राधिकां विधिः ॥ 4.15.130 ॥
4.15.m:
made them recite five mantras declared in the Vedas, O Nārada.
Having made him bow again, and having given Rādhikā over to Kṛṣṇa, Brahmā,

4.15.s:
kanyakāṃ ca yathā tāto bhaktyā tasthau hareḥ puraḥ ..
etasminnantare devāḥ sānandapulakodgamāḥ .. 131..
4.15.d:
कन्यकां च यथा तातो भक्त्या तस्थौ हरेः पुरः ॥
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवाः सानन्दपुलकोद्गमाः ॥ 131॥
4.15.m:
just like a father [giving away] his daughter, stood before Hari with devotion.
At that moment, the gods, thrilling with joy,

4.15.s:
dundubhiṃ vādayāmāsuścānakaṃ murajādikam..
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha .. 132 ..
4.15.d:
दुन्दुभिं वादयामासुश्चानकं मुरजादिकम्॥
पारिजातप्रसूनानां पुष्पवृष्टिर्बभूव ह ॥ 132 ॥
4.15.m:
sounded kettledrums, drums, and murajas.
A shower of flowers of pārijāta blossoms indeed fell;

4.15.s:
jagurgandharvapravarā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ ..
tuṣṭāva śrīhariṃ brahmā tamuvāca ha sasmitaḥ ..133..
4.15.d:
जगुर्गन्धर्वप्रवरा ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः ॥
तुष्टाव श्रीहरिं ब्रह्मा तमुवाच ह सस्मितः ॥133॥
4.15.m:
the best of the Gandharvas sang, and hosts of Apsarases danced.
Brahmā praised Śrī Hari, and said to him with a smile:

4.15.s:
yuvayoścaraṇāmbhoje bhaktiṃ me dehi dakṣiṇām..
brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca hariḥ svayam ..134..
4.15.d:
युवयोश्चरणाम्भोजे भक्तिं मे देहि दक्षिणाम्॥
ब्रह्मणो वचनं श्रुत्वा तमुवाच हरिः स्वयम् ॥134॥
4.15.m:
"Give me devotion to the lotus feet of you both as my priestly fee!"
Hearing Brahmā's words, Hari himself said to him:

4.15.s:
madīyacaraṇāmbhoje sudṛḍhā bhaktirastu te ..
svasthānaṃ gaccha bhadraṃ te bhavitā nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 135 ..
4.15.d:
मदीयचरणाम्भोजे सुदृढा भक्तिरस्तु ते ॥
स्वस्थानं गच्छ भद्रं ते भविता नात्र संशयः ॥ 135 ॥
4.15.m:
"May you have very firm devotion to my lotus feet;
go to your own abode; good fortune will be yours, there is no doubt of this.

4.15.s:
mayā niyojitaṃ karma kuru vatsa mamājñayā ..
śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā vidhātā jagatāṃ mune .. 136 ..
4.15.d:
मया नियोजितं कर्म कुरु वत्स ममाज्ञया ॥
श्रीकृष्णस्य वचः श्रुत्वा विधाता जगतां मुने ॥ 136 ॥
4.15.m:
Perform the work assigned by me, dear child, according to my command."
Hearing the words of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, O sage, the creator of the worlds,

4.15.s:
praṇamya rādhāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca jagāma svālayaṃ mudā ..
gate brahmaṇi sā devī sasmitā vakracakṣuṣā .. .. 137 ..
4.15.d:
प्रणम्य राधां कृष्णं च जगाम स्वालयं मुदा ॥
गते ब्रह्मणि सा देवी सस्मिता वक्रचक्षुषा ॥ ॥ 137 ॥
4.15.m:
bowed down to Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa and joyfully departed for his own abode.
When Brahmā had gone, the goddess, smiling, with a sidelong glance,

4.15.s:
sā dadarśa harervaktraṃ cacchāda vrīḍayā mukham ..
pulakāṅkitasarvāṃgī kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā .. 138 ..
4.15.d:
सा ददर्श हरेर्वक्त्रं चच्छाद व्रीडया मुखम् ॥
पुलकाङ्कितसर्वांगी कामबाणप्रपीडिता ॥ 138 ॥
4.15.m:
looked upon Hari's face, and covered her face with bashfulness.
Her limbs thrilling all over, tormented by the arrows of love,

4.15.s:
praṇamya śrīhariṃ bhaktyā jagāma śayanaṃ hareḥ ..
candanāgurupaṅkaṃ ca kastūrīkuṅkumānvitam..139..
4.15.d:
प्रणम्य श्रीहरिं भक्त्या जगाम शयनं हरेः ॥
चन्दनागुरुपङ्कं च कस्तूरीकुङ्कुमान्वितम्॥139॥
4.15.m:
having bowed with devotion to Śrī Hari, she went to Hari's couch.
Sandal and aguru paste mixed with musk and saffron,

4.15.s:
lalāṭe tilakaṃ kṛtvā dadau kṛṣṇasya vakṣasi ..
sudhāpūrṇaṃ ratnapātraṃ madhupūrṇaṃ manoharam .. 4.15.140 ..
4.15.d:
ललाटे तिलकं कृत्वा ददौ कृष्णस्य वक्षसि ॥
सुधापूर्णं रत्नपात्रं मधुपूर्णं मनोहरम् ॥ 4.15.140 ॥
4.15.m:
having made a mark on her forehead, she applied to Kṛṣṇa's chest.
A charming jewel vessel full of nectar and full of honey,

4.15.s:
pradadau haraye bhaktyā bubhuje jagatīpatiḥ ..
tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam .. 141 ..
4.15.d:
प्रददौ हरये भक्त्या बुभुजे जगतीपतिः ॥
ताम्बूलं च वरं रम्यं कर्पूरादिसुवासितम् ॥ 141 ॥
4.15.m: she offered with devotion to Hari, and the Lord of the world enjoyed it.

4.15.s:
dadau kṛṣṇāya sā rādhā sādaraṃ bubhuje hariḥ ..
cakhāda sasmitā rādhā haridattaṃ sudhārasam ..142..
4.15.d:
ददौ कृष्णाय सा राधा सादरं बुभुजे हरिः ॥
चखाद सस्मिता राधा हरिदत्तं सुधारसम् ॥142॥
4.15.m:
Rādhā gave to Kṛṣṇa, and Hari consumed it with respect.
Smiling, Rādhā ate the nectar-like elixir given by Hari;

4.15.s:
tāmbūlaṃ tena dattaṃ ca bubhuje purato hareḥ ..
kṛṣṇaścarvitatāmbūlaṃ rādhikāyai mudā dadau ..143..
4.15.d:
ताम्बूलं तेन दत्तं च बुभुजे पुरतो हरेः ॥
कृष्णश्चर्वितताम्बूलं राधिकायै मुदा ददौ ॥143॥
4.15.m:
and she consumed the betel roll given by him in Hari's presence.
Kṛṣṇa joyfully gave chewed betel to Rādhikā;

4.15.s:
cakhāda parayā bhaktyā papau tanmukhapaṅkajam ..
rādhācarvitatāmbūlaṃ yayāce madhusūdanaḥ ..144..
4.15.d:
चखाद परया भक्त्या पपौ तन्मुखपङ्कजम् ॥
राधाचर्वितताम्बूलं ययाचे मधुसूदनः ॥144॥
4.15.m:
she ate it with supreme devotion, and drank from the lotus of his face.
Madhusūdana begged for the betel chewed by Rādhā;

4.15.s:
jahāsa na dadau rādhā kṣametyuktaṃ tayā mudā..
candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumadravamuttamam ..
rādhikāyāśca sarvāṃge pradadau mādhavaḥ svayam .. 145 ..
4.15.d:
जहास न ददौ राधा क्षमेत्युक्तं तया मुदा॥
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरीकुङ्कुमद्रवमुत्तमम् ॥
राधिकायाश्च सर्वांगे प्रददौ माधवः स्वयम् ॥ 145 ॥
4.15.m:
Rādhā laughed and did not give it, saying joyfully, "Pardon me!"
The excellent ointment of sandal, aguru, musk, and saffron,
Mādhava himself applied to all of Rādhikā's limbs.

4.15.s:
yaḥ kāmo dhyāyate nityaṃ yasyaikacaraṇāmbujam ..
babhūva tasya sa vaśo rādhāsaṃtoṣakāraṇāt .. 146 ..
4.15.d:
यः कामो ध्यायते नित्यं यस्यैकचरणाम्बुजम् ॥
बभूव तस्य स वशो राधासंतोषकारणात् ॥ 146 ॥
4.15.m:
He whom Love ever meditates upon, on whose single lotus foot,
came under Love's sway for the sake of Rādhā's pleasure.

4.15.s:
yadbhṛtyabhṛtyairmadano jitaḥ sarvakṣaṇaṃ mune ..
svecchāmayo hi bhagavāñjitastena kutūhalāt ..147..
4.15.d:
यद्भृत्यभृत्यैर्मदनो जितः सर्वक्षणं मुने ॥
स्वेच्छामयो हि भगवाञ्जितस्तेन कुतूहलात् ॥147॥
4.15.m:
He by whose servants' servants Love is conquered at every moment, O sage—
the Lord whose will is free was conquered by Love out of playful sport.

4.15.s:
kare dhṛtvā ca tāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sthāpayāmāsa vakṣasi ..
cakāra śithilaṃ vastraṃ cumbanaṃ ca caturvidham ..148..
4.15.d:
करे धृत्वा च तां कृष्णः स्थापयामास वक्षसि ॥
चकार शिथिलं वस्त्रं चुम्बनं च चतुर्विधम् ॥148॥
4.15.m:
Taking her by the hand, Kṛṣṇa placed her on his chest;
he loosened her garment, and gave the four kinds of kisses.

4.15.s:
babhūva ratiyuddhena vicchinnā kṣudraghaṇṭikā ..
cumbanenauṣṭharāgaśca hyāśleṣeṇa ca patrakam ..149..
4.15.d:
बभूव रतियुद्धेन विच्छिन्ना क्षुद्रघण्टिका ॥
चुम्बनेनौष्ठरागश्च ह्याश्लेषेण च पत्रकम् ॥149॥
4.15.m:
Her belt of small bells was broken in the battle of love;
by kissing, the lip-colour was removed, and by embracing, the leaf-patterns [on her breasts];

4.15.s:
śṛṃgāreṇaiva kabarī sindūratilakaṃ mune ..
jagāmālaktakāṅkaśca viparītādikena ca ..4.15.150..
4.15.d:
शृंगारेणैव कबरी सिन्दूरतिलकं मुने ॥
जगामालक्तकाङ्कश्च विपरीतादिकेन च ॥4.15.150॥
4.15.m:
by love-play her braid and her vermilion forehead-mark were undone, O sage;
and the lac-dye marks vanished by reverse intercourse and other acts.

4.15.s:
pulakāṅkitasarvāṃṅgī babhūva navasaṃgamāt ..
mūrcchāmavāpa sā rādhā bubudhe na divāniśam ..151..
4.15.d:
पुलकाङ्कितसर्वांङ्गी बभूव नवसंगमात् ॥
मूर्च्छामवाप सा राधा बुबुधे न दिवानिशम् ॥151॥
4.15.m:
Her limbs all thrilling from the new union,
Rādhā fell into a swoon, and was unaware of day or night.

4.15.s:
pratyaṅgenaiva pratyaṅgamaṅgenāṅgaṃ samāśliṣat ..
śṛṅgārāṣṭavidhaṃ kṛṣṇaścakāra kāmaśāstravit..152..
4.15.d:
प्रत्यङ्गेनैव प्रत्यङ्गमङ्गेनाङ्गं समाश्लिषत् ॥
शृङ्गाराष्टविधं कृष्णश्चकार कामशास्त्रवित्॥152॥
4.15.m:
Limb by limb, body by body, he embraced her;
Kṛṣṇa, skilled in the science of love, performed the eight kinds of amorous sports.

4.15.s:
punastāṃ ca samāśliṣya sasmitāṃ vakralocanām ..
kṣatavikṣatasarvāṅgīṃ nakhadantaiścakāra ha ..153..
4.15.d:
पुनस्तां च समाश्लिष्य सस्मितां वक्रलोचनाम् ॥
क्षतविक्षतसर्वाङ्गीं नखदन्तैश्चकार ह ॥153॥
4.15.m:
Embracing her again, smiling and sidelong-eyed,
he covered all her limbs with scratches and marks from his nails and teeth.

4.15.s:
kaṅkaṇānāṃ kiṅkiṇīnāṃ mañjīrāṇāṃ manoharaḥ ..
babhūva śabdastatraiva śṛṅgārasamarodbhavaḥ .. 154 ..
4.15.d:
कङ्कणानां किङ्किणीनां मञ्जीराणां मनोहरः ॥
बभूव शब्दस्तत्रैव शृङ्गारसमरोद्भवः ॥ 154 ॥
4.15.m:
Of bracelets, small bells, and anklets a charming
sound arose right there, born of the battle of love-play.

4.15.s:
punastāṃ ca samākṛṣya śayyāyāṃ ca niveśya ca ..
cakāra rahitāṃ rādhāṃ kabarībandhavāsasā .. 155 ..
4.15.d:
पुनस्तां च समाकृष्य शय्यायां च निवेश्य च ॥
चकार रहितां राधां कबरीबन्धवाससा ॥ 155 ॥
4.15.m:
Drawing her close again and seating her on the bed,
he made Rādhā stripped of her hair-tie and garments.

4.15.s:
nirjane kautukātkṛṣṇaḥ kāmaśāstraviśāradaḥ ..
cūḍāveṣāṃśukairhīnaṃ cakāra taṃ ca rādhikā ..156..
4.15.d:
निर्जने कौतुकात्कृष्णः कामशास्त्रविशारदः ॥
चूडावेषांशुकैर्हीनं चकार तं च राधिका ॥156॥
4.15.m:
In secret, playfully, Kṛṣṇa, expert in the science of love [did this];
and Rādhikā rendered him stripped of his diadem, dress, and garments.

4.15.s:
na kasya kasmāddhāniśca tau dvau kāryaviśāradau ..
jagrāha rādhāhastāttu mādhavo ratnadarpaṇam ..157..
4.15.d:
न कस्य कस्माद्धानिश्च तौ द्वौ कार्यविशारदौ ॥
जग्राह राधाहस्तात्तु माधवो रत्नदर्पणम् ॥157॥
4.15.m:
Neither suffered any loss to the other; both were experts in love's duties.
Mādhava snatched the jewelled mirror from Rādhā's hand,

4.15.s:
muralīṃ mādhavakarājjagrāha rādhikā balāt ..
cittāpahāraṃ rādhāyāścakāra mādhavo balāt ..158..
4.15.d:
मुरलीं माधवकराज्जग्राह राधिका बलात् ॥
चित्तापहारं राधायाश्चकार माधवो बलात् ॥158॥
4.15.m:
and Rādhikā by force snatched the flute from Mādhava's hand.
Mādhava forcefully stole Rādhā's heart,

4.15.s:
jahāra rādhikā rāsānmādhavasyāpi mānasam ..
nivṛtte kāmayuddhe ca sasmitā vakralocanā..159..
4.15.d:
जहार राधिका रासान्माधवस्यापि मानसम् ॥
निवृत्ते कामयुद्धे च सस्मिता वक्रलोचना॥159॥
4.15.m:
and Rādhikā also carried away Mādhava's mind from the rāsa-dance.
When the battle of love had ceased, smiling, with sidelong eyes,

4.15.s:
pradadau muralīṃ prītyā śrīkṛṣṇāya mahātmane..
pradadau darpaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ krīḍākamalamujjvalam ..4.15.160..
4.15.d:
प्रददौ मुरलीं प्रीत्या श्रीकृष्णाय महात्मने॥
प्रददौ दर्पणं कृष्णः क्रीडाकमलमुज्ज्वलम् ॥4.15.160॥
4.15.m:
She affectionately gave the flute to the great-souled Śrī Kṛṣṇa;
Kṛṣṇa gave her a mirror and a radiant toy lotus.

4.15.s:
cakāra kabarīṃ ramyāṃ sindūratilakaṃ dadau..
vicitrapatrakaṃ veṣaṃ cakāraivaṃvidhaṃ hariḥ.. ..161..
4.15.d:
चकार कबरीं रम्यां सिन्दूरतिलकं ददौ॥
विचित्रपत्रकं वेषं चकारैवंविधं हरिः॥ ॥161॥
4.15.m:
Hari arranged her lovely braid and applied a tilaka of red vermilion;
he adorned her with decorative patterns on her skin, and dressed her in such a fashion

4.15.s:
viśvakarmā na jānāti sakhīnāmapi kā kathā ..
veṣaṃ vidhātuṃ kṛṣṇasya yadā rādhā samudyatā .. 162 ..
4.15.d:
विश्वकर्मा न जानाति सखीनामपि का कथा ॥
वेषं विधातुं कृष्णस्य यदा राधा समुद्यता ॥ 162 ॥
4.15.m:
that even Viśvakarman could not comprehend it, let alone her female companions.
When Rādhā was about to dress Kṛṣṇa,

4.15.s:
babhūva śiśurūpaṃ ca kaiśoraṃ ca vihāya ca ..
dadarśa bālarūpaṃ taṃ rudantaṃ pīḍitaṃ kṣudhā ..163..
4.15.d:
बभूव शिशुरूपं च कैशोरं च विहाय च ॥
ददर्श बालरूपं तं रुदन्तं पीडितं क्षुधा ॥163॥
4.15.m:
he abandoned his youth and became an infant in form.
She saw him in the form of a child, crying and afflicted with hunger,

4.15.s:
yādṛśaṃ pradadau nando bhītaṃ tādṛśamacyutam ..
viniśvasya ca sā rādhā hṛdayena vidūyatā ..164..
4.15.d:
यादृशं प्रददौ नन्दो भीतं तादृशमच्युतम् ॥
विनिश्वस्य च सा राधा हृदयेन विदूयता ॥164॥
4.15.m:
frightened, just as Acyuta had been when Nanda handed him over.
Sighing, that Rādhā, with an aching heart,

4.15.s:
itastatastaṃ paśyantī śokārtā virahāturā ..
uvāca kṛṣṇamuddiśya kākūktimiti kātarā .. 165 ..
4.15.d:
इतस्ततस्तं पश्यन्ती शोकार्ता विरहातुरा ॥
उवाच कृष्णमुद्दिश्य काकूक्तिमिति कातरा ॥ 165 ॥
4.15.m:
looking at him from this side and that, pained by grief and distressed by separation,
spoke in plaintive words to Kṛṣṇa, full of sorrow:

4.15.s:
māyāṃ karoṣi māyeśa kiṃkarīṃ kathamīdṛśīm ..
ityevamuktvā sā rādhā papāta ca ruroda ca .. ..166..
4.15.d:
मायां करोषि मायेश किंकरीं कथमीदृशीम् ॥
इत्येवमुक्त्वा सा राधा पपात च रुरोद च ॥ ॥166॥
4.15.m:
“O Lord of illusion, why do you cast such illusion upon your maidservant?”
Having spoken thus, that Rādhā fell down and wept.

4.15.s:
ruroda kṛṣṇastatraiva vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī ..
kathaṃ rodiṣi rādhe tvaṃ smara kṛṣṇapadāmbujam..167..
4.15.d:
रुरोद कृष्णस्तत्रैव वाग्बभूवाशरीरिणी ॥
कथं रोदिषि राधे त्वं स्मर कृष्णपदाम्बुजम्॥167॥
4.15.m:
Kṛṣṇa wept right there, and a bodiless voice arose:
“Why do you weep, O Rādhā? Remember Kṛṣṇa’s lotus feet.

4.15.s:
ārāsamaṇḍalaṃ yāvannaktamatrāgamiṣyati ..
kariṣyasi ratiṃ nityaṃ hariṇā sārddhamīpsitām ..168..
4.15.d:
आरासमण्डलं यावन्नक्तमत्रागमिष्यति ॥
करिष्यसि रतिं नित्यं हरिणा सार्द्धमीप्सिताम् ॥168॥
4.15.m:
He will come here at night, as far as the circle of the rāsa dance;
you will make the desired love with Hari constantly.

4.15.s:
chāyāṃ vidhāya svagṛhe svayamāgatya mā ruda ..
kṛtvā kroḍe ca prāṇeśaṃ māyeśaṃ bālarūpiṇam .. 169 ..
4.15.d:
छायां विधाय स्वगृहे स्वयमागत्य मा रुद ॥
कृत्वा क्रोडे च प्राणेशं मायेशं बालरूपिणम् ॥ 169 ॥
4.15.m:
Leaving your shadow at your home, coming yourself, do not weep!
Taking in your lap the Lord of your life, the Lord of illusion who has assumed the form of a child,

4.15.s:
tyaja śokaṃ gṛhaṃ gaccha sundarītthaṃ prabodhitā ..
śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ rādhā kṛtvā kroḍe ca bālakam .. .. 4.15.170 ..
4.15.d:
त्यज शोकं गृहं गच्छ सुन्दरीत्थं प्रबोधिता ॥
श्रुत्वैवं वचनं राधा कृत्वा क्रोडे च बालकम् ॥ ॥ 4.15.170 ॥
4.15.m:
give up grief and go home!” Thus comforted, O beautiful one,
Rādhā, having heard this speech and taking the child in her lap,

4.15.s:
dadarśa puṣpodyānaṃ ca vanaṃ sadratnamaṇḍapam ..
tūrṇaṃ vṛndāvanādrādhā jagāma nandamandiram .. 171 ..
4.15.d:
ददर्श पुष्पोद्यानं च वनं सद्रत्नमण्डपम् ॥
तूर्णं वृन्दावनाद्राधा जगाम नन्दमन्दिरम् ॥ 171 ॥
4.15.m:
saw the flower garden, the forest, and the pavilion made of fine gems.
Swiftly Rādhā went from Vṛndāvana to Nanda’s palace.

4.15.s:
sā manoyāyinī devī nimiṣārdhena nārada ..
saṃsiktasnigdhamadhurarasanā raktalocanā .. 172 ..
4.15.d:
सा मनोयायिनी देवी निमिषार्धेन नारद ॥
संसिक्तस्निग्धमधुररसना रक्तलोचना ॥ 172 ॥
4.15.m:
That goddess, moving as fast as thought in half a twinkling of an eye, O Nārada,
her charming tongue moist and gentle, her eyes red,

4.15.s:
yaśodāyai śiśuṃ dātumudyatā satyuvāca ha ..
gṛhītvaivaṃ śiśuṃ sthūlaṃ rudantaṃ ca kṣudhāturam .. 173 ..
4.15.d:
यशोदायै शिशुं दातुमुद्यता सत्युवाच ह ॥
गृहीत्वैवं शिशुं स्थूलं रुदन्तं च क्षुधातुरम् ॥ 173 ॥
4.15.m:
being ready to give the child to Yaśodā, truly said:
“Taking this plump child who is weeping and distressed by hunger,

4.15.s:
goṣṭhe tvatsvāminā dattaṃ prāpnomi yātanāṃ pathi ..
saṃsiktaṃ vasanaṃ vatse meghācchanne'tidurdine .. 174 ..
4.15.d:
गोष्ठे त्वत्स्वामिना दत्तं प्राप्नोमि यातनां पथि ॥
संसिक्तं वसनं वत्से मेघाच्छन्नेऽतिदुर्दिने ॥ 174 ॥
4.15.m:
given to me in the cow-pen by your husband, I have suffered agony on the road.
My garment is soaked, O dear child, on this exceedingly miserable day overcast with clouds;

4.15.s:
picchile kardamodreke yaśodā voḍhumakṣamā ..
gṛhāṇa bālakaṃ bhadre stanaṃ dattvā prabodhaya .. 175 ..
4.15.d:
पिच्छिले कर्दमोद्रेके यशोदा वोढुमक्षमा ॥
गृहाण बालकं भद्रे स्तनं दत्त्वा प्रबोधय ॥ 175 ॥
4.15.m:
Yaśodā, amid the slippery excess of mud, I am unable to carry him.
Take the boy, O gentle lady! Offer your breast and comfort him.

4.15.s:
gṛhaṃ ciraṃ parityaktaṃ yāmi tiṣṭha sukhaṃ sati ..
ityuktvā bālakaṃ dattvā jagāma svagṛhaṃ prati .. 176 ..
4.15.d:
गृहं चिरं परित्यक्तं यामि तिष्ठ सुखं सति ॥
इत्युक्त्वा बालकं दत्त्वा जगाम स्वगृहं प्रति ॥ 176 ॥
4.15.m:
My house has been left behind for a long time; I am going, stay in happiness, O virtuous lady!”
Having spoken thus and handed over the child, she went to her own house.

4.15.s:
yaśodā bālakaṃ nītvā cucumba ca stanaṃ dadau ..
bahirniviṣṭā sā rādhā svagṛhe gṛhakarmaṇi .. 177 ..
4.15.d:
यशोदा बालकं नीत्वा चुचुम्ब च स्तनं ददौ ॥
बहिर्निविष्टा सा राधा स्वगृहे गृहकर्मणि ॥ 177 ॥
4.15.m:
Yaśodā took the boy, kissed him, and gave him her breast.
That Rādhā, remaining outside in her home, attended to household duties;

4.15.s:
nityaṃ naktaṃ ratiṃ tatra cakāra hariṇā saha ..
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa śrīkṛṣṇacaritaṃ śubham ..
sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ puṇyamaparaṃ kathayāmi te .. 178 ..
4.15.d:
नित्यं नक्तं रतिं तत्र चकार हरिणा सह ॥
इत्येवं कथितं वत्स श्रीकृष्णचरितं शुभम् ॥
सुखदं मोक्षदं पुण्यमपरं कथयामि ते ॥ 178 ॥
4.15.m:
every night she made love there with Hari.
Thus has been recounted, O dear one, the auspicious deed of Śrī Kṛṣṇa,
which grants happiness and liberation, and is meritorious. I shall relate another to you.
